title: F1HR logo lockup with the line "HRMS Portal — Sign in to continue" (there is no text <h1>; the heading IS the logo image)
audience: public / unauthenticated — one single login for every role: platform-admin, HR, director and employee all sign in through this same form
purpose: Single sign-in screen for the whole product; the server decides from the database who you are and the page sends platform admins to /platform and everyone else to /home.
layout: Full-viewport (min-h-screen) flex box, contents centered both ways, 16px padding. Background is a diagonal gradient, top-left to bottom-right: slate-900 #0f172a -> slate-800 #1e293b -> brand-900 #1e293b (near-black navy). Centered column is max-width 448px (max-w-md), full width below that. Inside it, ONE white card: rounded-xl (12px), 1px slate-200 border, shadow-sm, 32px padding all round. Card contents stack top-to-bottom: (1) centered brand block — logo image then tagline — with 24px bottom margin; (2) optional session-timeout info alert with 16px bottom margin; (3) optional error alert with 16px bottom margin; (4) the sign-in form, fields spaced 16px apart, ending in a full-width submit button; (5) a noticeably empty gap at the bottom of the card where a 'forgot password' link would normally sit — there is none, and the blank space is real. Below the card, outside it, a centered 12px slate-400 footer line with 16px top margin. Browser tab title is "FOne HR — HRMS Portal". Fonts: system UI sans (ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto). Page is not scrollable at normal heights; layout is identical on mobile, just narrower.

widgets.label: Brand lockup (logo + tagline)
widgets.detail: Centered column. Top: rendered at height exactly 44px, width auto (the component reserves width = round(44 * 3.16) = 139px), object-fit contain, display block. It is a wordmark image, not text. Directly under it, 4px gap: the tagline paragraph "HRMS Portal — Sign in to continue" at 14px (text-sm), color slate-500, centered.

widgets.label: Session-timeout info alert (conditional)
widgets.detail: Rendered only when the URL carries ?timeout=1 (the 15-minute idle logout redirects here with that query). Style: rounded-lg, 1px border-blue-200, bg-blue-50, text-blue-700, padding 12px vertical / 16px horizontal, 14px text. Exact copy, one line: "You were logged out after 15 minutes of inactivity." Sits above the error alert when both are present.

widgets.label: Error alert (conditional)
widgets.detail: Rendered only after a failed submit. Style: rounded-lg, 1px border-red-200, bg-red-50, text-red-700, padding 12px/16px, 14px text. Body is the raw server error string, no icon, no title, no dismiss button.

widgets.label: Sign-in form
widgets.detail: Two fields, 16px vertical rhythm, then a full-width submit. FIELD 1 — label "Employee ID / Email / Username" (label style throughout the app: block, 12px, font-semibold, slate-600, UPPERCASE, letter-spacing wide, 4px bottom margin). Input: plain text input, full width, rounded-lg, 1px slate-300 border, 12px horizontal / 8px vertical padding, 14px text, white background, focus ring 2px brand-500; placeholder "e.g. EMP004 or you@company.com"; required; autofocus on page load; no client-side format validation — an employee code, an email address or a username are all accepted and the server disambiguates. FIELD 2 — label "Password". Input type=password (switches to type=text when revealed), same input style plus 40px right padding (pr-10) to clear the icon; placeholder is eight bullet characters "••••••••"; required; NO minLength on this screen. Overlaid at the right edge of the password input, vertically centred 12px from the right: a borderless icon button showing the lucide "Eye" icon at 16px in slate-400 (hover slate-600); once the password is revealed it swaps to the lucide "EyeOff" icon. SUBMIT — full-width button, brand-600 background #1d4ed8, white text, rounded-lg, 14px font-medium, 10px vertical padding (py-2.5), label "Sign in"; while the request is in flight the same button is disabled at 50% opacity with the label "Signing in…" (note the single-character ellipsis). There is no Remember me checkbox, no Forgot password link, no Sign up link and no SSO / Google / Microsoft button anywhere on this page.

widgets.label: Footer legal line
widgets.detail: Outside and below the card, centered, 12px (text-xs), slate-400, 16px top margin. Exact copy: "FOne HR v2.0 — © 2026 FOne HR. All rights reserved."

actions: Sign in (form submit / Enter key) — POSTs { identifier, password } to /api/auth/login; on success writes the token and user object to localStorage (keys fonehr_token, fonehr_user) and replaces the route with /platform when the returned user has admin:true, otherwise /home. On failure it stops the spinner and paints the red alert; the typed values stay in the fields.
Show / hide password — the eye button toggles the password input between masked and plain text; it is type=button so it never submits the form.
No other controls exist on this screen — nothing destructive, no modals, no links off the page.
states: Default: both fields empty, cursor already in the identifier field, no alerts, button enabled and reading "Sign in".
Submitting: button disabled at 50% opacity reading "Signing in…"; the two inputs stay editable and are NOT disabled; no overlay or spinner anywhere else.

Error: red alert appears above the form and the button returns to "Sign in". Real server messages to mock: "Invalid credentials" (both a wrong password and an unknown account return this same wording on purpose), "Identifier and password are required", "Too many failed sign-in attempts. This account is locked for 12 more minute(s)." (after 5 consecutive failures), "This ID exists in more than one company — please log in with your email address", "Your company account is suspended. Contact the administrator.", "This account has been disabled. Contact HR.", "This account is locked. Contact HR.", "Session expired".
Timed-out arrival: blue info alert visible above the form (and above the red one if both apply) because the URL is /login?timeout=1.
Password revealed: input shows plain text and the trailing icon is EyeOff instead of Eye.
No loading skeleton, no empty state and no permission-denied state exist here — the page is public and renders instantly.
Already signed in: nothing special happens on this route; the redirect lives on / instead.
mockData: Identifier field filled with "EMP004"; password field showing 8 bullets. Placeholder text as shipped: "e.g. EMP004 or you@company.com". For an error variant use "Invalid credentials"; for the locked variant use "Too many failed sign-in attempts. This account is locked for 12 more minute(s)." A plausible signed-in identity behind this form: Sneha Iyer, EMP004, sneha.iyer@futurn.in, Software Engineer, Engineering, Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd. Footer exactly "FOne HR v2.0 — © 2026 FOne HR. All rights reserved."

title: (no visible heading — blank routing gate, renders null)
audience: every visitor; it is the entry URL for employee, hr, admin and platform-admin alike
purpose: Invisible landing route that reads the saved session out of localStorage and immediately bounces the visitor to the right home page; it paints no UI of its own.
layout: Renders literally nothing (returns null). What is on screen is the bare document body: flat slate-100 (#f1f5f9) background, no header, no sidebar, no spinner, no logo, no text. It is visible only for the single frame before the redirect fires in a useEffect. For a static mockup, reproduce it as an empty slate-100 page (optionally with a note that it redirects), NOT as a splash screen — there is no splash screen in the code.

widgets.label: Redirect rules (no DOM, behaviour only)
widgets.detail: On mount: if there is no token in localStorage.fonehr_token OR no user object in localStorage.fonehr_user -> router.replace('/login'). Otherwise, if user.admin is true -> router.replace('/platform'); if user.admin is false -> router.replace('/home'). A code comment records the bug this fixed: testing user.role === 'admin' never matched because the API returns role 'ADMIN' and marks the account with admin:true, which sent platform admins to /dashboard where they saw "No employee profile linked to this account".

actions: No user-facing actions. The only behaviour is the automatic client-side redirect described above.
states: No session -> /login.
Session with admin:true -> /platform.
Session with admin:false (employee, HR, director, custom role) -> /home.
Corrupt JSON in localStorage.fonehr_user is swallowed and treated as no user, so it falls through to /login.
No loading, empty, error or permission-denied rendering exists — the page never shows anything.
mockData: localStorage.fonehr_user for the employee path: { "username": "EMP004", "admin": false, "role": "EMPLOYEE", "company": { "id": 1, "name": "Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd", "slug": "futurn" }, "employee": { "emp_code": "EMP004", "first_name": "Sneha", "last_name": "Iyer" } }. For the platform path: { "username": "platformadmin", "admin": true, "role": "ADMIN" }. Token key fonehr_token holds an opaque bearer string.

title: Change Password
audience: employee (and identically hr, director, any custom role, and platform-admin — this is the one page every signed-in account can always reach; it is always the LAST item in the sidebar)
purpose: Lets a signed-in user replace their own password by confirming the current one, inside the standard authenticated app shell.
layout: Standard authenticated shell. LEFT: fixed dark sidebar, 256px wide, full height, bg-slate-900 (#0f172a), visible from the lg breakpoint up; below lg it is hidden and opens as an overlay drawer from the left over a slate-900/60 scrim. RIGHT: content column offset by 256px on large screens, containing a sticky white top bar (border-b slate-200, 12px vertical padding, 16px horizontal on mobile / 32px on desktop, sits at the top on scroll) and then the page body with 16px padding on mobile / 32px on desktop, over the slate-100 app background. PAGE BODY, top to bottom: (1) page header row — "Change Password" at 24px bold slate-800 with the subtitle "Update your account password" at 14px slate-500 4px under it; the header's right-hand action slot is EMPTY on this page; 24px bottom margin. (2) A single white card, rounded-xl, slate-200 border, shadow-sm, 24px padding, constrained to max-width 512px (max-w-lg) and left-aligned — it does NOT stretch across the page, so there is a large empty area to its right on desktop. Inside the card: optional red error alert, optional green success alert, then the three-field form at 16px rhythm, then the submit button (inline, sized to its text, NOT full width). SIDEBAR internals, top to bottom: brand block (logo-light.png at 30px height on the dark background, 20px padding, bottom border slate-800, plus a close X button visible only on mobile); a company strip (11px uppercase slate-500 caption "Company" over the company name in 14px semibold slate-200, truncated); the scrollable nav (12px horizontal padding, 16px vertical, 4px between items); and a bottom bar separated by a slate-800 border holding the Logout button.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (permission-driven — items a user was not granted simply do not appear)
widgets.detail: EMPLOYEE / HR / DIRECTOR build, in this exact order. Collapsible group "Home" (lucide Home icon, chevron rotates 180 when open) containing: Home -> /home (Home icon), Dashboard -> /dashboard (LayoutDashboard). Collapsible group "Attendance & Leave" (CalendarCheck) containing: Attendance -> /attendance (CalendarCheck), Leave Balance -> /leave/balance (Scale), Apply Leave -> /leave/apply (FilePlus2), Leave History -> /leave/history (History), and Approvals -> /leave/approvals (ClipboardCheck) ONLY with permission leaves.approve. Collapsible group "Documents" (FolderOpen) containing: Salary Slips -> /documents/salary-slips (FileText), Offer Letter -> /documents/offer-letter (FileBadge), Company Policies -> /documents/policies (BookOpen). Flat link "Payroll" -> /admin/payroll (Banknote) ONLY with documents.manage. Then a section label "MANAGEMENT" (11px semibold uppercase slate-500, 12px horizontal padding) above flat links, each gated: Overview -> /admin (LayoutDashboard, employees.view), Employees -> /admin/employees (Users, employees.view), Attendance -> /admin/attendance (CalendarClock, attendance.view_all), Leave Management -> /admin/leaves (ClipboardCheck, leaves.view_all), Leave Balances -> /admin/balances (Calculator, balances.manage), Documents -> /admin/documents (FolderOpen, documents.manage), Reports -> /admin/reports (BarChart3, reports.view), Analytics -> /admin/analytics (LineChart, analytics.view), Settings -> /admin/settings (Settings, settings.manage), Email Log -> /admin/emails (Mails, settings.manage), Roles & Access -> /admin/access (ShieldCheck, platform admin only). Last item always: "Change Password" -> /change-password (KeyRound) — ACTIVE on this screen. Item styling: rounded-lg, 12px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, 14px font-medium, icon 18px, 12px gap; resting colour slate-300 on transparent, hover bg-slate-800 with white text, ACTIVE state solid brand-600 (#1d4ed8) background with white text. Group children are indented 16px behind a 1px slate-700 left rule, 15px icons, 14px text, slate-400 resting.

widgets.label: Sidebar company strip
widgets.detail: Between the logo block and the nav, 20px horizontal / 10px vertical padding, bottom border slate-800. Caption "Company" in 11px uppercase slate-500 with wide tracking, and under it the company name in 14px semibold slate-200, single line, truncated with an ellipsis if long. Shown only when a company is known (always true for tenant users).

widgets.label: Top bar
widgets.detail: Sticky white strip. Left: hamburger (lucide Menu, 22px, slate-600) shown only below lg, then a 14px slate-500 line reading "FOne HR — Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd" for tenant users (hidden on very small screens). Right, 20px apart: the notification bell (non-admin only) and the user chip. USER CHIP: right-aligned two-line text — the display name in 14px semibold slate-800 (first_name + ' ' + last_name for employees, the username for platform admins) and beneath it 12px slate-500 reading role + ' · ' + employee code, e.g. "EMPLOYEE · EMP004" (platform admins read simply "Platform Admin") — followed by a 36px circular brand-600 avatar holding the uppercased initials of the first two words of the display name in 14px bold white, e.g. "SI".

widgets.label: Notification bell + dropdown (non-admin only; never rendered for platform admins)
widgets.detail: Bell trigger: lucide Bell 20px, slate-500, 6px padding, circular hover bg-slate-100; when there are unread items a red-500 pill sits on its top-right corner with a 2px white ring showing the unread count in 9px bold white (min width 16px, height 16px). The list is polled every 10 seconds and refreshed on window focus. Clicking opens a dropdown anchored to the bell's right edge, 8px below it: 320px wide, white, rounded-xl, slate-200 border, shadow-lg. Header row (slate-50, bottom border, 16px/10px padding): the word "Notifications" in 12px bold slate-700 on the left and, only when unread > 0, a "Mark all as read" text button in 11px semibold brand-600 on the right. Body: max height 256px, scrollable, rows divided by 1px slate-100 lines. Each row: title in 12px semibold (slate-800 when unread, slate-600 once read) with a 6px brand-500 dot on the right while unread, then the body text clamped to two lines in 11px slate-500, then the timestamp in 9px slate-400 formatted DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS. Unread rows carry a faint brand-50/30 tint. Empty body: centered italic 12px slate-400 "No notifications yet." Footer (only when the list is non-empty): a full-width slate-50 button with a top border reading "View all notifications" in 11px semibold brand-600. Clicking any row, or the footer, closes the dropdown and opens the drawer below. Clicking anywhere outside closes the dropdown.

widgets.label: Notification reader drawer (slides in from the right)
widgets.detail: Full-height right-hand drawer over a slate-900/50 scrim, width 100% up to a 448px maximum, background slate-50, heavy shadow, slides in over 200ms and slides out before unmounting; Escape closes it and the page behind it is locked from scrolling. Header (white, bottom border, 20px/16px padding): a brand-600 Bell icon 18px, then "Notifications" in 14px bold slate-800 with an 11px slate-500 line under it reading either "3 unread" or, at zero, "All caught up"; on the right a "Mark all read" button (11px semibold brand-600 with a CheckCheck icon, only while unread > 0) and a close X button (18px, slate-400). Body: 16px padding, cards 10px apart. Each card is a white rounded-xl bordered article; unread cards additionally carry a 4px brand-500 left edge; the expanded card's border turns brand-500. Card header button: the title in 14px (bold slate-900 while unread, semibold slate-700 once read) with a 6px brand-500 dot while unread, the body clamped to two lines in 12px slate-500 ONLY while collapsed, the timestamp in 11px slate-400, and a chevron on the right that rotates 180 when open. Expanded card: a top-bordered region showing the full body with whitespace preserved in 14px slate-700, plus — only if the notification carries a link — an "Open" text button in 12px semibold brand-600 with a small right arrow. Opening a card marks that one read. Empty state: centred, 80px of vertical space, a 36px slate-300 Bell, "No notifications yet" in 14px semibold slate-600 and "Leave updates and announcements will appear here." in 12px slate-400.

widgets.label: Sidebar logout
widgets.detail: Pinned to the bottom of the dark sidebar above a slate-800 top border, 12px padding. Full-width row, rounded-lg, 12px/10px padding, 14px font-medium slate-300, lucide LogOut icon 18px with a 12px gap, label "Logout"; on hover the whole row turns red-600/90 with white text.

widgets.label: Change password form (inside the max-w-lg white card)
widgets.detail: Three fields at 16px rhythm, all required, all using the shared input style (full width, rounded-lg, slate-300 border, 12px/8px padding, 14px, white, brand-500 focus ring) with 40px right padding for the reveal icon, and all labelled in the app's 12px uppercase semibold slate-600 label style. FIELD 1: label "Current Password", type=password, required, no minLength, no placeholder, own Eye/EyeOff toggle. FIELD 2: label "New Password", type=password, required, minLength 8 enforced by the browser, no placeholder, own Eye/EyeOff toggle, and a helper line beneath it in 12px slate-400: "Minimum 8 characters." FIELD 3: label "Confirm New Password", type=password, required, no minLength, no placeholder, own Eye/EyeOff toggle, no helper text. Each toggle is an independent borderless button pinned 12px from the right of its own input, vertically centred, lucide Eye at 16px in slate-400 (hover slate-600), swapping to EyeOff while that field is revealed — the three fields reveal independently. SUBMIT: a brand-600 button with white text, rounded-lg, 16px/8px padding, 14px font-medium, label "Update Password", inline width (not full width), left-aligned under the last field; while saving it is disabled at 50% opacity and reads "Updating…". There is no Cancel button and no password-strength meter.

widgets.label: Form alerts (inside the card, above the form)
widgets.detail: Error variant: rounded-lg, border-red-200, bg-red-50, text-red-700, 12px/16px padding, 14px text, 16px bottom margin. Success variant: same box with border-emerald-200, bg-emerald-50, text-emerald-700. Only one is shown at a time — submitting clears both before the request goes out.

actions: Update Password (submit) — first compares New Password with Confirm New Password locally and refuses with an error before any network call; otherwise POSTs { currentPassword, newPassword } to /api/auth/change-password. On success it paints the green alert with the server's message and blanks all three fields. (The backend also emails the user a security notice telling them to inform HR straight away if the change was not theirs — that email is invisible on this screen.)
Show / hide current password — toggles field 1 only.
Show / hide new password — toggles field 2 only.
Show / hide confirm password — toggles field 3 only.
Any sidebar link — navigates away; on mobile the tap also closes the drawer.
Collapse / expand a sidebar group (Home, Attendance & Leave, Documents) — a group auto-opens when the current path is inside it.
Hamburger (mobile) — opens the sidebar drawer; the scrim or the X closes it.
Notification bell — opens the dropdown and refreshes the list; opening the bell does NOT mark anything read.
Mark all as read (dropdown or drawer) — PUT /api/notifications/read-all, clears every unread dot and the bell count.
Click a notification row — closes the dropdown, opens the drawer scrolled to that card expanded, and marks that single one read.
View all notifications — opens the drawer with nothing pre-expanded.
Open (inside an expanded notification) — closes the drawer and routes to the notification's link.
Logout (destructive-ish) — clears fonehr_token, fonehr_user and fonehr_company from localStorage and replaces the route with /login. No confirmation dialog.
states: Default: three empty password fields, no alerts, button enabled reading "Update Password".
Client-side mismatch error, shown with no network call: "New password and confirmation do not match".
Saving: button disabled at 50% opacity reading "Updating…"; fields stay editable.
Success: green alert with "Password changed successfully" and all three fields reset to empty.

Server errors (red alert, fields keep their values): "Current password is incorrect", "Password must be at least 8 characters", "That password is too common — please choose another" (blocked list includes Welcome@123, Admin@123, password, Password1, 12345678, changeme), "Password is too long" (over 200 characters), "The new password must be different from the current one", "Both current and new password are required".

Not signed in / expired token: the shell renders nothing at all (a blank slate-100 page) and immediately replaces the route with /login; any 401 from the API also wipes the session and hard-navigates to /login.
Idle 15 minutes (no mousemove, keydown, click, scroll or touch): the session is cleared and the browser goes to /login?timeout=1, which is what raises the blue alert on the login screen.
Permission-denied: not applicable — this page is reachable by every authenticated account, and unavailable menu items are hidden rather than disabled.

Platform-admin variant of the same page: the sidebar shows only "Companies" and "Change Password" (plus the Management block if a company is currently open), the top bar reads "FOne HR — Platform Console", the user chip's second line reads "Platform Admin", and the notification bell is absent entirely.
Below the lg breakpoint: sidebar is hidden behind the hamburger, the top-bar context line is hidden on the smallest widths, and the card goes edge-to-edge within the 16px page padding.
No loading skeleton — the form has nothing to fetch; the shell simply renders nothing until the session is read.

title: Companies
audience: platform-admin only (accounts with admin:true; any non-admin who lands here is bounced to /dashboard)
purpose: The multi-tenant console where the platform owner creates companies, opens one to administer it, suspends or reactivates it, and permanently deletes it with all its data.
layout: Same authenticated shell as /change-password, in its platform-admin form: 256px dark slate-900 sidebar on the left (holding "Companies", active, and "Change Password" — plus the whole MANAGEMENT block only once a company has been opened), sticky white top bar reading "FOne HR — Platform Console" (or "FOne HR — Managing: <company name>" when a company is selected), user chip with the admin's username over the line "Platform Admin" and a brand-600 initials avatar, NO notification bell. Body padding 16px mobile / 32px desktop on the slate-100 background. BODY, top to bottom: (1) page header row, wrapping, space-between — on the left "Companies" at 24px bold slate-800 over the subtitle "Each company is fully isolated — its own database schema, files, roles and users" at 14px slate-500; on the right a brand-600 primary button "+ New Company"; 24px bottom margin. (2) alert slot (red error, then green success), each 16px above the content. (3) the main region, which is exactly one of: a centred spinner, a single centred empty-state card, or the company grid. GRID: 1 column on mobile, 2 from the md breakpoint, 3 from xl, 16px gap, cards equal width and self-sizing in height.

widgets.label: Page header action
widgets.detail: One button, right-aligned in the header row: brand-600 background, white text, rounded-lg, 16px/8px padding, 14px font-medium, lucide Plus icon at 16px with an 8px gap, label "New Company". It opens the Create Company modal with an empty form (name '', slug '', biometric unchecked).

widgets.label: Error / success alerts
widgets.detail: Error: rounded-lg, border-red-200, bg-red-50, text-red-700, 12px/16px padding, 14px, 16px bottom margin; it persists until the next successful action. Success: the emerald variant (border-emerald-200, bg-emerald-50, text-emerald-700) carrying the server's message and disappearing on its own after exactly 4 seconds. Showing one clears the other.

widgets.label: Company card grid
widgets.detail: One card per company, sorted by name. Card: white, rounded-xl, slate-200 border, shadow-sm, 20px padding; the company currently selected as the admin's working tenant additionally carries a 2px brand-500 ring around the whole card. Contents top to bottom: ROW 1 (space-between, items aligned to the top) — on the left a 10px-padded rounded-lg tile with a brand-50 background holding the lucide Building2 icon at 22px in brand-600; on the right a 6px-gap badge row: an optional blue pill "Biometric" (bg-blue-100, text-blue-700) rendered only when the company has device attendance enabled, followed always by the status pill, green (bg-emerald-100/text-emerald-700) reading "Active" or red (bg-red-100/text-red-700) reading "Suspended". All pills are rounded-full, 10px horizontal / 2px vertical padding, 12px font-medium, no wrapping. ROW 2 (12px top margin): the company name in bold slate-800. ROW 3: a 12px slate-400 metadata line formatted exactly "slug: futurn · created 2026-02-14" — note the created date is printed as the raw ISO YYYY-MM-DD (first ten characters of the timestamp), NOT in the DD/MM/YYYY style the rest of the app uses. ROW 4 (8px top margin): a 14px slate-600 count line formatted exactly "128 employee(s) · 6 pending leave(s)" — the literal "(s)" is always printed, even at one or zero. ROW 5 (16px top margin, 8px gap): the action button row described separately below.

widgets.label: Per-card actions
widgets.detail: Three controls in one row. (1) "Open" — brand-600 primary, flex:1 so it eats the remaining width, lucide LogIn icon at 15px with an 8px gap, white text. (2) A square secondary icon button (white, slate-300 border, slate-700, rounded-lg, 12px horizontal padding): lucide PauseCircle at 16px with the tooltip "Suspend" when the company is Active, or lucide PlayCircle with the tooltip "Activate" when it is Suspended — the two never appear together. (3) A square secondary icon button with the lucide Trash2 icon at 16px forced to red-600, tooltip "Delete company".

widgets.label: Create Company modal
widgets.detail: Centred dialog over a full-screen slate-900/50 scrim; clicking the scrim closes it. Panel: white card, rounded-xl, slate-200 border, 24px padding, max-width 512px, full width below that, max height 90vh with its own vertical scroll. Header row (16px bottom margin): title "Create Company" at 18px bold slate-800 on the left, and on the right a borderless × (a 2xl multiplication sign, slate-400 hovering slate-600). Body is a form at 16px rhythm: FIELD 1 — label "Company Name", standard text input, placeholder "Acme Industries", required. FIELD 2 — label "Slug (optional — short id, letters/digits)", standard text input, placeholder "acme", NOT required, with a 12px slate-400 helper beneath: "Used for the isolated database schema and file folder. Derived from the name if left empty." (server-side the slug is lower-cased, stripped of everything except a-z0-9, truncated to 24 characters, and must end up at least 2 characters long). FIELD 3 — a checkbox with an inline 14px slate-700 label, 8px gap: "This company uses fingerprint / biometric attendance", with a 12px slate-400 helper beneath: "Enables the device features: attendance sync, entry/exit times for employees and HR, and the Device Mapping panel." FOOTER — right-aligned, 8px gap: a secondary "Cancel" button (white, slate-300 border, slate-700) and the brand-600 primary submit "Create Company", which while saving is disabled at 50% opacity and reads "Creating…". The modal shows no alert of its own — failures surface in the page-level red alert after it closes or stays open.

widgets.label: Native confirm() dialogs (browser-chrome, not styled)
widgets.detail: SUSPEND: one confirm reading exactly "Suspend \"Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd\"? Its users will not be able to log in." ACTIVATE: one confirm reading exactly "Activate \"Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd\"?" (no trailing sentence). DELETE: two confirms in sequence — first "DELETE \"Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd\" permanently?" then a blank line and "This erases the company's entire database schema, all employees, attendance, leave and documents. This CANNOT be undone."; only if that is accepted, a second confirm reading "Really sure? Final confirmation." Cancelling either step aborts with nothing changed. In a static mockup these should be drawn as OS-style dialogs, not as the app's own modal.

widgets.label: Empty state (conditional — replaces the grid)
widgets.detail: One centred white card, rounded-xl, slate-200 border, 48px padding, column layout, centre-aligned text: a lucide Building2 icon at 40px in slate-300 with a 12px bottom margin, then "No companies yet" in semibold slate-700, then "Create your first company, then open it to add HR, the Director and employees." in 14px slate-500 with a 4px top margin. The header's "New Company" button stays visible above it. No button inside the empty card.

widgets.label: Loading state (conditional — replaces the grid)
widgets.detail: A single centred spinner with 64px of vertical padding: a 32px circle with a 4px slate-200 border whose top edge is brand-600, rotating continuously. Nothing else — no skeleton cards, no text.

actions: New Company — opens the Create Company modal.

Create Company (modal submit) — POSTs { name, slug, has_device_attendance } to /api/companies, which provisions an isolated PostgreSQL schema named c_<slug>, an uploads folder, the system roles (OWNER, DIRECTOR, HR, EMPLOYEE) and four leave types seeded at a 0/month accrual rate (Casual Leave CL, Earned Leave EL, Sick Leave SL, Comp Off CO) so employees start with zero leave until HR grants it. On success the modal closes, the grid reloads and the green alert shows e.g. "Company \"Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd\" created".
Cancel / × / scrim click — closes the modal and discards whatever was typed.

Open — stores { id, name, slug } as the admin's selected company in localStorage (fonehr_company, which is also sent as the x-company-slug header on every later request) and pushes /admin; from then on the sidebar grows the whole MANAGEMENT block and the top bar reads "Managing: <name>".

Suspend (destructive) — native confirm, then PUT /api/companies/:id with { status: 'Suspended' }; green alert "Company suspended"; the card's pill turns red and its users can no longer log in (they get "Your company account is suspended. Contact the administrator.").
Activate — native confirm, then PUT with { status: 'Active' }; green alert "Company activated".

Delete company (irreversible, two confirms) — DELETE /api/companies/:id drops the entire tenant schema with CASCADE, deletes the directory rows and removes the uploads folder from disk; if the deleted company was the one selected, the selection is cleared too. Green alert "Company \"Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd\" and all its data deleted".
Sidebar: Companies (current), Change Password, Logout — as in the shell.
states: Loading: the centred spinner, shown while GET /api/companies is in flight (the header and its button are already visible).
Empty: the "No companies yet" card when the list comes back as an empty array.
Populated: the 1/2/3-column card grid.
Selected company: that one card carries a 2px brand-500 ring — this is the company the admin most recently opened.
Suspended company: red "Suspended" pill, and the middle icon button shows a play triangle (Activate) instead of pause.
Biometric company: an extra blue "Biometric" pill to the left of the status pill.

Error: red alert under the header carrying the API message, e.g. "A company with that name or slug already exists" (409), "Company name is required", "Slug must be at least 2 letters/digits", "Invalid status", "Company not found", "Request failed". The grid keeps showing whatever it last loaded.
Success: green alert that clears itself after 4 seconds.
Saving inside the modal: the submit button disabled at 50% opacity reading "Creating…"; the fields stay editable and Cancel stays live.

Permission-denied: a signed-in NON-admin who reaches /platform is redirected to /dashboard on mount — there is no styled 403 page. An unauthenticated visitor is sent to /login by the shell, and any 401 wipes the session and hard-navigates to /login.
Idle 15 minutes -> /login?timeout=1, same as everywhere in the shell.
Responsive: one column with full-width cards on phones and the sidebar behind the hamburger; two columns from 768px; three from 1280px.

title: Leave Management
purpose: HR/Director approval inbox and full history of every leave application in the company, with a month-by-month list of approved leaves underneath.
layout: Wrapped in AppShell. FIXED DARK SIDEBAR, 256px (w-64), bg-slate-900, full height, visible at lg+ only (below lg it is a slide-over opened by a hamburger in the topbar, with a slate-900/60 backdrop): top block = FOne HR logo (light variant, 30px) with a border-b border-slate-800; then a company block (border-b border-slate-800, px-5 py-2.5) reading label 'COMPANY' (11px uppercase tracking-wide slate-500) over the company name (text-sm font-semibold slate-200); then the scrolling nav (px-3 py-4, space-y-1) grouped into labelled sections whose headers are 11px font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider slate-500; nav links are rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm with a 18px lucide icon, inactive = slate-400 on hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white, ACTIVE = bg-brand-600 (#1d4ed8) text-white font-medium — here 'Leave Management' is active; a border-t footer holds a full-width 'Logout' button (LogOut icon, slate-300, hover:bg-red-600/90 hover:text-white). MAIN COLUMN is lg:pl-64. STICKY TOPBAR: white, border-b border-slate-200, px-4 lg:px-8 py-3, flex justify-between — left shows 'FOne HR — Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd' (text-sm slate-500, hidden on xs), right shows a notification bell with a red unread dot, the user's display name and role. PAGE BODY on bg-slate-100, top-to-bottom: (1) PageHeader — h1 'Leave Management' (text-2xl font-bold slate-800) with subtitle 'A single approval from HR or the Director fully approves a request' (text-sm slate-500), no right-side action buttons on this page; (2) optional red error Alert then optional green success Alert, each mb-4, full width; (3) a flex-wrap row of five rounded-full filter pills, gap-2, mb-4; (4) the leave applications table inside a white rounded-xl card (border-slate-200, shadow-sm, overflow-x-auto, mb-8) spanning the full content width; (5) the 'Leave Calendar (approved leaves)' card (card p-6) with its heading and month stepper on one flex-wrap justify-between row, and below it a 1-col / sm:2-col / xl:3-col grid of purple leave cards. Modals render centered over a slate-900/50 full-screen overlay.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (AppShell)
widgets.detail: Sections and items, in order, each with a lucide icon: SELF-SERVICE — Home (/home), Dashboard (/dashboard), Attendance (/attendance), Leave Balance (/leave/balance), Apply Leave (/leave/apply), Leave History (/leave/history), Approvals (/leave/approvals, only with leaves.approve); DOCUMENTS — Salary Slips (/documents/salary-slips), Offer Letter (/documents/offer-letter), Company Policies (/documents/policies); MANAGEMENT — Overview (/admin), Employees (/admin/employees), Attendance (/admin/attendance), Leave Management (/admin/leaves) [ACTIVE on this screen], Leave Balances (/admin/balances), Payroll (/admin/payroll), Documents (/admin/documents), Reports (/admin/reports), Analytics (/admin/analytics), Settings (/admin/settings), Email Log (/admin/emails), Roles & Access (/admin/access); then Change Password (/change-password) and the Logout button in the footer.

widgets.label: Status filter pills
widgets.detail: Five mutually exclusive rounded-full pill buttons in this exact order, rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium border: 'Awaiting Approval' (status=Pending, SELECTED BY DEFAULT), 'All', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'Cancelled'. Selected pill = bg-brand-600 border-brand-600 text-white; unselected = bg-white border-slate-300 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50. No counts or badges on the pills.

widgets.label: Leave applications table
widgets.detail: Exact column headers, left to right: '#', 'Employee', 'Type', 'Dates', 'Days', 'Reason', 'Doc', 'Status', 'Decided By', 'Actions' (Actions header is right-aligned). Headers are px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider on a bg-slate-50 thead; body rows divide-y divide-slate-100 with hover:bg-slate-50; cells px-4 py-3 text-sm. Cell contents: '#' = '#47' in slate-400; 'Employee' = two stacked lines, full name (font-medium slate-800) over emp_code (text-xs slate-500); 'Type' = the leave CODE only (CL/EL/SL/CO), and directly beneath it an amber Badge reading 'Unpaid' when the application is unpaid (probation); 'Dates' = 'DD/MM/YYYY → DD/MM/YYYY' on one non-wrapping line joined by a right arrow; 'Days' = plain number, may be a decimal; 'Reason' = free text clipped at max-width 200px with an ellipsis and the full text as a hover tooltip; 'Doc' = a brand-600 paperclip icon button when a document is attached, otherwise an em dash '—'; 'Status' = a pill Badge, with 'Pending' RELABELLED to 'Awaiting Approval' (amber), Approved=green/emerald, Rejected=red, Cancelled=slate; 'Decided By' = text-xs actor string like 'Priya Sharma (HR)' or '—' when undecided; 'Actions' = right-aligned icon buttons (see button-row).

widgets.label: Row action icons (Actions column)
widgets.detail: Right-aligned, gap-1.5, icon-only buttons with tooltips, conditionally rendered. On Pending rows (and only if the viewer holds leaves.approve): a 17px green check icon, title 'Approve', emerald-600 with hover:bg-emerald-100; and a 17px red X icon, title 'Reject', red-600 with hover:bg-red-100. On any row whose status is NOT Cancelled and NOT Rejected (again only with leaves.approve): a 16px Ban/slash icon, title 'Cancel leave', slate-500 with hover:bg-slate-200. So a Pending row shows three icons, an Approved row shows only the Ban icon, and Rejected/Cancelled rows show none.

widgets.label: Status and Unpaid badges
widgets.detail: Badge = inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium, no border. Colour map used on this screen: 'Awaiting Approval' = bg-amber-100 text-amber-700; 'Approved' = bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700; 'Rejected' = bg-red-100 text-red-700; 'Cancelled' = bg-slate-100 text-slate-600; the 'Unpaid' marker in the Type column = bg-amber-100 text-amber-700.

widgets.label: Leave Calendar (approved leaves)
widgets.detail: A white card (card p-6) — NOT a day grid. Header row (flex-wrap, justify-between, gap-3, mb-4): h3 'Leave Calendar (approved leaves)' (font-bold slate-800) on the left; on the right a MonthPicker = [←] btn-secondary arrow button, a centre label of min-width 150px showing the month as 'September 2026' (block text-sm font-semibold slate-700; no secondary period line on this page), and a [→] btn-secondary arrow button. Arrows wrap the year at January/December. Body is a ul grid: 1 column, sm:2 columns, xl:3 columns, gap-3. Each item is a rounded-lg card with border-purple-200 and bg-purple-50, p-3: line 1 = employee full name in text-sm font-semibold purple-900 followed by the emp_code in parentheses at normal weight; line 2 = 'CODE · DD/MM/YYYY → DD/MM/YYYY' in text-xs purple-700. Only APPROVED leaves overlapping the selected payroll cycle appear.

widgets.label: Reject Leave Application (modal)
widgets.detail: Centred modal over a slate-900/50 overlay; white card, max-w-lg, max-h-90vh, p-6, scrollable. Header row: title 'Reject Leave Application' (text-lg font-bold slate-800) with a slate-400 '×' close button at the right. Form, space-y-4: field label 'REJECTION REASON' (block text-xs font-semibold slate-600 uppercase tracking-wide) above a 3-row textarea (full-width rounded-lg border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm, brand-500 focus ring) with placeholder 'Why is this request being rejected?'; the textarea is REQUIRED — submitting empty is blocked by the browser. Footer, right-aligned gap-2: 'Cancel' (btn-secondary, white/slate-300 border) and 'Reject Application' (btn-danger, bg-red-600 text-white).

widgets.label: Cancel-leave confirmation (native browser confirm)
widgets.detail: A native confirm() dialog, not a styled modal. Text: 'Cancel leave #47 for Sneha Iyer?' — and when the leave being cancelled is already Approved, the sentence ' Balance and attendance will be restored.' is appended. OK proceeds with the destructive delete, Cancel aborts.

widgets.label: Error / success banners
widgets.detail: Full-width rounded-lg banners with a 1px border, px-4 py-3 text-sm, stacked above the filter pills. Error = bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200 and shows the raw API message (it persists until the next successful action). Success = bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 and auto-clears after 4 seconds. Sample success texts: 'Leave approved — employee and manager notified by email.', 'Leave rejected', 'Leave cancelled — balance and attendance restored'.

widgets.label: Loading spinner
widgets.detail: An 8x8 (32px) spinning ring, border-4 border-slate-200 with a brand-600 top border, centred in a py-16 block. Used twice and independently: once in place of the whole table card while applications load, and once inside the calendar card while the month loads.

actions: Click any of the five status pills — refetches GET /api/leaves?status=<value>, blanks the table to the spinner first; 'Awaiting Approval' (Pending) is the landing state.

Approve (green check, Pending rows only, requires leaves.approve) — POST /api/leaves/{id}/approve. Single-step: fully approves, deducts the leave balance, overwrites those attendance days as 'Leave', and emails both the employee and their reporting manager. Shows the green banner 'Leave approved — employee and manager notified by email.' and reloads BOTH the table and the calendar.
Reject (red X, Pending rows only, requires leaves.approve) — opens the 'Reject Leave Application' modal; no request is sent yet.

Submit 'Reject Application' inside the modal — POST /api/leaves/{id}/reject with the typed reason, closes the modal, shows the success banner, reloads the table (the calendar is NOT reloaded, since rejection cannot change approved leaves).

Cancel leave (Ban icon, any status except Cancelled/Rejected, requires leaves.approve) — DESTRUCTIVE. Shows the native confirm first, then DELETE /api/leaves/{id}; for an already-approved leave this reverses the balance deduction and un-marks the attendance days. Reloads table and calendar.

Paperclip in the Doc column — fetches the protected attachment as a blob with the auth header and opens it in a NEW BROWSER TAB (it is not an inline preview). A failure fills the red error banner instead.
MonthPicker ← / → — steps the Leave Calendar one month back/forward, wrapping the year, and refetches GET /api/leaves/calendar?year&month. Only the calendar card reloads; the table is untouched.
Modal '×' or 'Cancel' — closes the reject modal and discards the typed reason.
Sidebar 'Logout' — clears the session and returns to /login. The whole shell also force-logs-out after 15 minutes of no mouse/key/scroll/touch activity, landing on /login?timeout=1.
states: Loading (table): rows are null — the entire table card is replaced by the centred spinner; the filter pills stay visible and clickable.
Loading (calendar): the calendar card keeps its heading and month stepper and shows its own spinner in the body.
Empty (table): a single full-width row spanning all 10 columns, centred slate-500, py-10, reading 'No leave applications match this filter.'
Empty (calendar): 'No approved leaves in this month.' as plain text-sm slate-500 — no card grid.

Error: red Alert at the top of the page carrying the API message (e.g. 'Not allowed', 'Leave application not found', 'Cannot reject an application that is Approved'). It stays until the next successful action clears it.
Success: green Alert at the top that disappears on its own after 4 seconds.
Permission-denied (no leaves.approve): the page still lists everything, but the Actions column renders completely empty for every row while its header remains — a read-only audit view.

Permission-denied (no leaves.view_all): the 'Leave Management' sidebar link is not rendered at all, and reaching the route directly returns 403 which surfaces as the red error banner over an empty page.
Session expiry / 401: the session is cleared and the browser is redirected to /login.

Conditional rendering inside rows: the amber 'Unpaid' badge appears only on probation-period applications; the Doc cell is a paperclip or an em dash; 'Decided By' is an em dash until someone acts; a Pending status always renders with the word 'Awaiting Approval', never 'Pending'; long reasons are clipped to 200px with the full text in a hover tooltip.

title: Leave Balances
purpose: HR configures how many days of each leave type accrue every month, sees the whole company's accrued/used/remaining grid, and makes manual per-employee corrections with a full audit ledger.
layout: Same AppShell chrome as /admin/leaves (256px dark sidebar with 'Leave Balances' as the ACTIVE nav item, sticky white topbar, lg:pl-64 content column on bg-slate-100). PAGE BODY top-to-bottom: (1) PageHeader row — h1 'Leave Balances' (text-2xl font-bold slate-800) with subtitle 'Monthly accrual rates, accumulated balances and manual adjustments (decimals supported)', and on the RIGHT of the same row a single btn-secondary 'Run Accrual Now' carrying a 16px refresh icon; (2) optional red error Alert then green success Alert, mb-4; (3) CARD ONE 'Monthly Accrual Rates' (card p-6 mb-6) containing, in order: a flex justify-between header (h3 with a brand-600 calculator icon + a btn-secondary 'Add Leave Type' with a plus icon), an explanatory paragraph, a slate-50 accrual-day strip capped at max-w-2xl, and a responsive tile grid of leave types (1 col, sm:2, xl:4, gap-3); (4) CARD TWO 'Balance Grid' (card overflow-x-auto) with a px-4 pt-4 pb-1 heading block and then a full-width table whose column count grows with the number of leave types. Four modals render over a slate-900/50 overlay — three at max-w-lg and the ledger at max-w-3xl.

widgets.label: Page header action
widgets.detail: One button on the PageHeader's right: 'Run Accrual Now', btn-secondary (white, border-slate-300, text-slate-700, hover:bg-slate-50), rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium, with a 16px lucide RefreshCw icon to the left of the label.

widgets.label: Monthly Accrual Rates card — header and description
widgets.detail: h3 'Monthly Accrual Rates' in font-bold slate-800 with an 18px brand-600 Calculator icon; on the right of the same row a btn-secondary 'Add Leave Type' with a 15px Plus icon. Below, a text-sm slate-500 paragraph reading exactly: 'Days credited to every employee at the start of each month. Balances accumulate and carry over — accrual also runs automatically every day (current period: 2026-09).' where the trailing value is the live YYYY-MM period.

widgets.label: Monthly Accrual Day strip
widgets.detail: A flex-wrap gap-3 strip inside bg-slate-50, p-3, rounded-lg, border-slate-100, max-w-2xl. Left: the static label 'MONTHLY ACCRUAL DAY:' (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider slate-500). DISPLAY MODE: a blue Badge reading 'Day 24 of the month' (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 pill) followed by a text-xs brand-600 font-semibold hover:underline link-button 'Change accrual day'. EDIT MODE (replaces both): an inline form with a number input (type=number, min=1, max=28, required, narrow ~64px, centred, text-sm font-semibold, reduced padding), then a btn-primary 'Save' at text-xs and a btn-secondary 'Cancel' at text-xs. Values outside 1–28 are rejected by the server with 'Accrual day must be a number between 1 and 28'. Default when unset is 24.

widgets.label: Leave type tiles (accrual rate editors)
widgets.detail: A grid — 1 column, sm:2, xl:4, gap-3 — of rounded-lg border-slate-200 p-3 tiles, one per leave type, in id order. Tile line 1: '<Name> (<CODE>)' as text-sm font-semibold slate-700, immediately followed by a 12px Pencil icon button (title 'Edit type', slate-400 → hover brand-600); pushed to the far right, a 14px Trash2 icon button (title 'Delete type', slate-300 → hover red-600). Tile line 2 (mt-2, flex gap-2): a number input (type=number, step=0.01, min=0, width ~96px) holding that type's monthly accrual, then the static text 'days / month' (text-xs slate-500), then — pushed right — a compact btn-secondary icon button with a 14px Save/floppy icon and title 'Save rate'. The input edits locally; nothing is persisted until the save icon is clicked.

widgets.label: Balance Grid
widgets.detail: Heading block above the table: h3 'Balance Grid' (font-bold slate-800) with the sub-line 'accrued − used = balance · click a cell to adjust manually' (text-xs slate-500). Table headers, left to right: 'Employee' followed by ONE COLUMN PER LEAVE TYPE headed by that type's CODE only — with the seeded types that is: 'Employee', 'CL', 'EL', 'SL', 'CO' (the header row grows automatically when a type is added). thead is bg-slate-50 with the standard uppercase 11–12px slate-500 header style; rows divide-y divide-slate-100 with hover:bg-slate-50; the whole card scrolls horizontally when the type count is wide. EMPLOYEE CELL: full name (font-medium slate-800), emp_code beneath it (text-xs slate-500), and below that a small inline link-button 'Ledger' (text-xs brand-600 hover:underline) with a 12px ScrollText icon. BALANCE CELL: a clickable button (title 'Adjust balance', rounded-lg with a transparent border that becomes border-brand-400 with a brand-50 background on hover, px-2 py-1, left-aligned) showing the remaining balance big in font-semibold brand-700, and directly under it an 11px slate-400 line in the exact form '<accrued> acc · <used> used' (accrued rounded to at most 2 decimals). When an employee has no balance row for that type the cell is a plain em dash '—' and is not clickable. Rows are ordered by emp_code, and only Active employees appear.

widgets.label: Adjust balance (modal)
widgets.detail: max-w-lg modal. Title is dynamic: 'Adjust CL — Sneha Iyer' (pattern: 'Adjust <TYPE CODE> — <employee name>'), with a '×' close at the right. Form, space-y-4: FIELD 1 label 'ADJUSTMENT (DAYS — DECIMALS ALLOWED, NEGATIVE TO DEDUCT)' above a number input (type=number, step=0.01, no min — negatives are the documented way to deduct, REQUIRED) with placeholder 'e.g. 2.5 or -1'; FIELD 2 label 'NOTE' above a plain text input (optional) with placeholder 'e.g. comp-off credit for weekend release'. Footer right-aligned gap-2: 'Cancel' (btn-secondary) and 'Apply Adjustment' (btn-primary, bg-brand-600 white text). Server rejects a zero or non-numeric delta with 'Employee, leave type and a non-zero adjustment are required'. A successful save credits/debits the ACCRUED figure and writes an 'adjustment' ledger row attributed to the logged-in username.

widgets.label: Leave Ledger (wide modal)
widgets.detail: max-w-3xl modal, title pattern 'Leave Ledger — Sneha Iyer (FTRN012)'. OPTIONAL blue info Alert at the top, shown only while the employee is still inside their probation window: 'On probation until 2026-11-30 — balance locked (no accrual, unpaid leave only).' (the date is printed raw as YYYY-MM-DD, not reformatted). Body is a max-height 420px vertically scrolling area holding a table with a STICKY bg-slate-50 header. Exact column headers in order: 'When', 'Type', 'Change', 'Kind', 'Note', 'By'. Cells: 'When' = the raw database timestamp, text-xs, no wrap, printed as-is e.g. '2026-09-01 00:05:12' (deliberately NOT converted to DD/MM/YYYY); 'Type' = the leave code; 'Change' = the signed delta, font-semibold, emerald-700 when zero-or-positive and shown with a leading '+', red-600 when negative; 'Kind' = a Badge mapped as accrual → blue 'Accrual', adjustment → purple 'Adjustment', leave_taken → red 'Leave taken', leave_cancelled → green 'Leave cancelled' (any unrecognised kind falls back to a slate badge printing the raw value); 'Note' = text-xs clipped at 260px; 'By' = the actor's username, text-xs. Newest entry first, capped at 200 rows.

widgets.label: Edit Leave Type (modal)
widgets.detail: max-w-lg modal titled 'Edit Leave Type', prefilled from the tile that was clicked. Two stacked fields, space-y-4: 'NAME' — text input, required; 'CODE' — text input, required (the server upper-cases and trims whatever is typed). Footer right-aligned: 'Cancel' (btn-secondary) and 'Save Changes' (btn-primary). A clash returns the error 'A leave type with that name or code already exists'.

widgets.label: Add Leave Type (modal)
widgets.detail: max-w-lg modal titled 'Add Leave Type'. Field 1 full width: 'NAME' — text input, required, placeholder 'Paternity Leave'. Then a TWO-COLUMN grid (gap-4): left 'CODE' — text input, required, placeholder 'PL'; right 'MONTHLY ACCRUAL' — number input, step=0.01, min=0, required, PRE-FILLED WITH 1. Footer right-aligned: 'Cancel' (btn-secondary) and 'Add Type' (btn-primary). On success every employee gets a balance row opened at 0 and the banner reads 'Leave type added — balances opened at 0 for all employees'.

widgets.label: Delete-leave-type confirmation (native browser confirm)
widgets.detail: A native confirm() dialog, text: 'Delete leave type "Comp Off"? Only possible if it was never used.' OK proceeds to the destructive delete; the server refuses with an error banner if any application references the type.

widgets.label: Badges used on this screen
widgets.detail: Pill style is inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Blue (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700) for the 'Day 24 of the month' accrual-day chip and for 'Accrual' ledger rows; purple (bg-purple-100 text-purple-700) for 'Adjustment'; red (bg-red-100 text-red-700) for 'Leave taken'; emerald (bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700) for 'Leave cancelled'; slate (bg-slate-100 text-slate-600) as the unknown-kind fallback.

widgets.label: Error / success banners
widgets.detail: Same banner components as the leaves screen, stacked directly under the PageHeader. Error = bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200. Success = bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200, auto-clearing after 4 seconds. Real message strings: 'Casual Leave: 1 day(s) will accrue per month', 'Accrual day updated to the 24th of every month', 'Accrual credited on 128 balance row(s)', 'All balances already up to date for this month', 'Balance adjusted by +2.5 day(s)', 'Leave type added — balances opened at 0 for all employees', 'Leave type updated', 'Leave type deleted'; error examples: 'Cannot delete: 37 application(s) reference this type', 'Monthly accrual must be a non-negative number (decimals allowed)'.

widgets.label: Loading spinner
widgets.detail: The same 32px brand-600 ring in a centred py-16 block. It replaces BOTH cards at once — while loading, the page shows only the PageHeader (with its working 'Run Accrual Now' button) and the spinner.

actions: 'Run Accrual Now' (header) — POST /api/balances/run-accrual, credits every month still owed to every balance row immediately, then reloads the page data. Banner reads 'Accrual credited on N balance row(s)' or 'All balances already up to date for this month'.
'Add Leave Type' (+) — opens the Add Leave Type modal with Monthly Accrual pre-filled at 1.
Submit 'Add Type' — POST /api/balances/types, opens a zero balance row for every employee, closes the modal and reloads. Duplicate name or code returns a 409 error banner.
Pencil icon on a tile — opens the Edit Leave Type modal prefilled with that type's name and code (the accrual rate is NOT editable here; it is edited on the tile itself).
Submit 'Save Changes' — PUT /api/balances/types/{id} with name and code, closes the modal and reloads.

Trash icon on a tile — DESTRUCTIVE. Shows the native confirm, then DELETE /api/balances/types/{id}, which also wipes that type's balance rows. Refused outright if even one leave application references the type.

Edit a tile's rate input then click its Save icon — PUT /api/balances/rates/{id} with the new monthly_accrual (decimals allowed, negatives rejected) and reloads. Editing the input alone changes nothing on the server.

'Change accrual day' — flips the strip into inline edit mode; 'Save' submits PUT /api/balances/accrual-day (1–28 enforced both in the input and on the server) and drops back to the badge; 'Cancel' restores the previously saved day.
Click any balance cell in the grid — opens the Adjust modal for that exact employee-and-type pair.

Submit 'Apply Adjustment' — POST /api/balances/adjust with a signed decimal delta and an optional note; adds to the accrued figure, writes an audited ledger entry, closes the modal and reloads the grid.
'Ledger' link under an employee's name — GET /api/balances/ledger/{employeeId} and opens the wide Leave Ledger modal for that employee (up to the 200 most recent entries).
Any modal '×' or 'Cancel' — closes without saving and discards the typed values.
states: Loading: both cards are replaced by a single centred spinner; the accrual-day lookup is fetched separately and fails SILENTLY, falling back to a displayed default of 'Day 24 of the month'.
Empty (no employees): one row spanning 1 + (number of leave types) columns, centred slate-500, py-8, reading 'No active employees yet.' The accrual rates card above it still renders normally.
Empty (ledger): 'No balance changes recorded yet.' centred, text-sm slate-500, py-6, inside the ledger modal with no table at all.

Probation: inside the ledger modal only, a blue info Alert above the table — 'On probation until <YYYY-MM-DD> — balance locked (no accrual, unpaid leave only).' — shown only while today is on or before that date.
Missing balance row: an individual grid cell renders a non-clickable em dash '—' instead of a balance button (this is what a newly added leave type looks like before accrual runs for an employee).
Accrual-day strip has two mutually exclusive states: read-only badge + 'Change accrual day' link, or the inline number-input form with Save/Cancel.
Error: red Alert under the header carrying the API message; it also clears any success message.
Success: green Alert under the header, gone after 4 seconds.

Permission-denied: the whole route requires balances.manage — without it the 'Leave Balances' sidebar link is never rendered, and hitting the URL directly 403s into the red error banner with an otherwise empty page.
Session expiry / 401: session cleared and redirect to /login. The shell additionally force-logs-out after 15 minutes idle.

title: Overview
purpose: Management home for HR/Director inside a selected company: headline headcount and leave counters, today's attendance mix, department strength, the pending-approval leave queue and the latest audit-log activity.
layout: Full app shell from components/AppShell.jsx wraps every /admin page. LEFT: fixed dark sidebar, 256px wide (w-64), bg-slate-900, full height, hidden below lg where it becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by a hamburger (Menu icon) in the topbar with a slate-900/60 backdrop. Sidebar top: 'FOne HR' logo mark (light variant, 30px) with a border-b border-slate-800 divider, px-5 py-5. Below it a company strip, px-5 py-2.5, border-b: 11px uppercase tracking-wide slate-500 label 'COMPANY' over a slate-200 semibold truncated company name. Then a scrolling nav, px-3 py-4, space-y-1: a top item 'Companies' (Building2 icon) only for the platform admin; then a section label 'MANAGEMENT' (11px uppercase tracking-wider slate-500) over the links, each rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm with an 18px lucide icon: Overview (LayoutDashboard), Employees (Users), Attendance (CalendarClock), Leave Management (ClipboardCheck), Leave Balances (Calculator), Documents (FolderOpen), Reports (BarChart3), Analytics (LineChart), Settings (Settings), Email Log (Mails), Roles & Access (ShieldCheck); then a standalone 'Change Password' (KeyRound). The active link is bg-brand-600 (#1d4ed8) with white text — on this screen that is 'Overview'; inactive links are slate-300 with hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white. Sidebar footer, border-t border-slate-800 p-3: full-width 'Logout' button (LogOut icon, slate-300, hover bg-red-600/90 white). RIGHT: the page area is pushed lg:pl-64. Sticky white topbar, border-b border-slate-200, px-4 lg:px-8 py-3, flex justify-between: left is the hamburger (mobile only) plus a text-sm slate-500 line 'FOne HR — Managing: <Company Name>'; right is a text-right block with the user's name in text-sm semibold slate-800 over their role in text-xs slate-500, followed by a 36px (h-9 w-9) round bg-brand-600 white-bold-initials avatar. The notification bell is NOT rendered for admin/HR-console users. MAIN: p-4 lg:p-8 over a slate-100 page background. Inside main, top to bottom: (1) PageHeader — 2xl bold slate-800 'Overview' with a text-sm slate-500 subtitle beneath, mb-6, no right-side buttons. (2) Stat-card grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4, gap-4, mb-6, four cards. (3) A second grid, grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3, gap-6, of three white cards (card = bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm), each p-6. Column 1 card holds TWO stacked sections: 'Today's Attendance' then, after mt-6, 'Department Strength'. Column 2 card is the pending-leave queue with a 'View all' link in its header row. Column 3 card is the audit-log feed. Section headings inside cards are font-bold text-slate-800, mb-4 (mb-3 for the second heading in column 1).

widgets.label: Total Employees
widgets.detail: Metric: total count of employee records in the company (all statuses). Plain integer, no unit, no sub-line. Card layout: white card p-5, flex row gap-4; left is a rounded-lg p-2.5 icon tile using lucide Users at 22px in the default brand palette (text-brand-600 on bg-brand-50, i.e. blue #1d4ed8 on #f0f6ff); right is a text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide slate-500 label above a text-2xl font-bold slate-800 value.

widgets.label: Active Employees
widgets.detail: Metric: count of employees whose status = 'Active'. Plain integer, no unit. Same card anatomy; icon lucide UserCheck; tile palette text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50.

widgets.label: Departments
widgets.detail: Metric: number of rows in the departments table (does NOT include the synthetic 'Unassigned' bucket). Plain integer, no unit. Icon lucide Building2; tile palette text-purple-600 bg-purple-50.

widgets.label: Pending Leave Requests
widgets.detail: Metric: count of leave applications with status = 'Pending'. Plain integer, no unit. Icon lucide ClipboardCheck; tile palette text-amber-600 bg-amber-50.

widgets.label: Today's Attendance
widgets.detail: Heading 'Today's Attendance' (font-bold slate-800, mb-4) inside the first card. A ul with space-y-2.5; each li is flex items-center justify-between: LEFT a pill badge carrying the status name, RIGHT the count in text-sm font-semibold. Only statuses that actually have a count today are rendered, and they are always rendered in this fixed order: Present, WFH, Half Day, Leave, Absent, Holiday, Weekend. Badge = inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium; colour map: Present = emerald-100/emerald-700, WFH = cyan-100/cyan-700, Half Day = amber-100/amber-700, Leave = purple-100/purple-700, Absent = red-100/red-700, Holiday = blue-100/blue-700, Weekend = slate-100/slate-600. Empty state replaces the list with a text-sm slate-500 line: 'No attendance records for today.'

widgets.label: Department Strength
widgets.detail: Second section of the first card: heading 'Department Strength' (font-bold slate-800, mt-6 mb-3) over a ul with space-y-2. Each li is a text-sm flex justify-between: department name on the left (text-slate-600), active headcount on the right in font-semibold. Ordered by headcount descending. A synthetic last row named 'Unassigned' appears only when some active employees have no department: it renders in text-amber-700 italic and is followed by a text-xs text-amber-600 suffix '(no department set)'. When at least one row exists, a final summary row sits under a border-t border-slate-200 pt-2: left 'Total (active)' in font-semibold slate-700, right the sum of all the counts above (including Unassigned) in font-bold. Empty state: a single text-sm slate-500 li reading 'No departments yet.'

widgets.label: Leave Requests Awaiting Approval
widgets.detail: Second card. Header row is flex justify-between mb-4: heading 'Leave Requests Awaiting Approval' (font-bold slate-800) and, on the right, a text-sm font-medium brand-600 hover:underline link labelled 'View all' pointing at /admin/leaves. Body is a ul space-y-3 of at most 6 pending requests (newest applied_at first). Each li is a rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-3 block containing: row 1 = flex justify-between with the employee's full name in text-sm font-semibold slate-800 followed by the employee code in slate-400 parentheses, e.g. 'Sneha Iyer (FTRN009)', and on the right an amber badge whose text is the relabelled status — 'Pending' is displayed as 'Awaiting Approval'; row 2 = text-xs slate-500, mt-1, formatted exactly as '<LEAVE CODE> · DD/MM/YYYY → DD/MM/YYYY (<days>d)', e.g. 'CL · 24/09/2026 → 25/09/2026 (2d)'. Leave codes come from the leave_types table: CL (Casual Leave), EL (Earned Leave), SL (Sick Leave), CO (Comp Off). Empty state: a single text-sm slate-500 li reading 'No pending requests. 🎉'

widgets.label: Recent Activity (Audit Log)
widgets.detail: Third card. Heading 'Recent Activity (Audit Log)' (font-bold slate-800, mb-4) over a ul space-y-3 of the 8 most recent audit rows, newest first. Each li has a left rail: border-l-2 border-slate-200 pl-3, and three stacked lines — (1) text-sm slate-700 with the ACTION CODE in font-semibold (upper snake case, e.g. EMPLOYEE_CREATED, EMPLOYEE_UPDATED, EMPLOYEE_DELETED, PASSWORD_RESET, ACCOUNT_LOCK, ACCOUNT_UNLOCK, ACCOUNT_ENABLE, ACCOUNT_DISABLE, PROBATION_SET, PROBATION_REMOVED, PHOTO_UPLOADED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED, ATTENDANCE_BULK, PAYROLL_EXPORTED, SALARY_STRUCTURE_UPDATED, HOLIDAY_ADDED, POLICY_UPLOADED); (2) text-xs slate-500 free-text details; (3) text-[11px] slate-400 mt-0.5 reading '<actor> · DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS', where actor is the acting user's username (an employee code such as FTRN002) or '<username> (platform admin)' when a platform admin did it. No empty-state text — the list simply renders nothing when there are no rows.

widgets.label: No company selected (full-page empty state, not a dialog)
widgets.detail: Conditional replacement for the entire page body, shown when the signed-in user is a platform admin and no company has been selected. A single white card, p-12, flex-col items-center text-center: lucide Building2 at 40px in text-slate-300 with mb-3; a font-semibold slate-700 line 'No company selected'; a text-sm slate-500 line 'Open a company from the platform console to manage it.' (mt-1 mb-4); and a primary button 'Go to Companies' (bg-brand-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium) that routes to /platform. The stat cards, the three panels and the PageHeader are all absent in this state.

widgets.label: Status pills used across the page
widgets.detail: One shared Badge component: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap. Palettes available: green (emerald-100/emerald-700), red (red-100/red-700), amber (amber-100/amber-700), blue (blue-100/blue-700), purple (purple-100/purple-700), slate (slate-100/slate-600), cyan (cyan-100/cyan-700); any unmapped colour falls back to slate. Leave-status mapping: Pending = amber (label rewritten to 'Awaiting Approval'), Manager Approved = blue, HR Approved = purple, Approved = green, Rejected = red, Cancelled = slate.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (app shell)
widgets.detail: Permission-gated menu; items the user lacks permission for are simply absent. For an HR/Director console session the rendered order is: section header 'MANAGEMENT' then Overview (/admin, active here), Employees (/admin/employees), Attendance (/admin/attendance), Leave Management (/admin/leaves), Leave Balances (/admin/balances), Documents (/admin/documents), Reports (/admin/reports), Analytics (/admin/analytics), Settings (/admin/settings), Email Log (/admin/emails), Roles & Access (/admin/access — platform admin only); then an ungrouped 'Change Password' (/change-password), then the Logout button pinned at the bottom. A platform admin also gets a 'Companies' (/platform) item above the section.

actions: 'View all' link in the pending-leave card header → navigates to /admin/leaves (text link, no confirmation).
'Go to Companies' primary button → router.push('/platform'); only present in the no-company-selected empty state.
Sidebar links navigate to the corresponding /admin/* routes; the current route's link is highlighted bg-brand-600.
'Logout' button in the sidebar footer → clears the stored session (token, user, company) and replaces the route with /login.
Hamburger (Menu icon, below lg) opens the sidebar drawer; the X button inside the drawer or a click on the backdrop closes it.
No destructive actions, no modals and no forms are reachable from this screen.
Background behaviour worth showing as a note only: a 15-minute inactivity timer logs the user out to /login?timeout=1.
states: Loading: while /admin/overview is in flight the whole body is a single centred spinner — an 8x8 (32px) rounded-full border-4 border-slate-200 with border-t-brand-600, animate-spin, inside a flex justify-center py-16 block. No skeleton cards.
Error: the body is replaced by one red Alert — rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700 — carrying the server's error message (e.g. 'Request failed').

Permission denied / no company: platform admin with no company selected gets the 'No company selected' card described above instead of the dashboard. A user without the employees.view permission never sees the Overview link at all and the API would answer 403.
Empty — attendance: 'No attendance records for today.' in place of the status list.
Empty — departments: 'No departments yet.'; the 'Total (active)' summary row is hidden when there are no department rows.
Empty — pending leave: 'No pending requests. 🎉'
Empty — audit log: nothing renders (bare card body under the heading).
Conditional row: the amber italic 'Unassigned … (no department set)' department row appears only when active employees exist with department_id NULL.
Conditional rows: attendance statuses with a zero/absent count are omitted entirely rather than shown as 0.
Session expiry: any 401 from the API clears the session and hard-redirects to /login.
