title: Payroll Management
purpose: Lets an HR/payroll user review every active employee's fixed monthly salary breakdown and statutory deductions side by side, and edit any one of them — including PAN and bank account details — in a modal.
layout:
SAME Next.js route as the previous screen (/admin/payroll). The '#salary-structures' fragment above is a labelling convenience for the mockup only — the real app has no such URL; this view is reached purely by clicking the second tab, and the page header, alerts, tab strip and search box are byte-identical to the Run Payroll screen.

App shell is unchanged: fixed 256px slate-900 sidebar with 'Payroll' highlighted, sticky white top bar, slate-100 page, main at p-4 lg:p-8.

MAIN CONTENT, top to bottom:
1. PageHeader — h1 'Payroll Management' (text-2xl font-bold slate-800) over the subtitle 'Manage salary structures and generate monthly salary slips' (text-sm slate-500 mt-0.5), mb-6.
2. Alert slot — same success/error banners, same missing bottom margin.
3. Control row — identical tab strip (now with 'Salary Structures' underlined in brand-600 and 'Run Payroll' in slate-500) and the same 288px search field on the right.
4. A SINGLE .card with overflow-x-auto holding a nine-column table that runs edge to edge. There is no filter card on this tab — no month, no year, no period readout, no export button. Salary structures are not dated; they are the current standing figures.
5. Modal overlay when a row's Edit is clicked — same geometry as the other tab (fixed inset-0 z-50, slate-900/50 backdrop, centred .card panel at max-w-lg / 512px, max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, p-6, title left and '×' right).

widgets.label: Payroll section tabs
widgets.detail: The same two tabs — 'Run Payroll' then 'Salary Structures' — with the second one active here: border-b-2 border-brand-600 and text-brand-700, while 'Run Payroll' is border-transparent text-slate-500. Same pb-3 px-1 text-sm font-medium sizing on a shared border-b border-slate-200 rail with gap-4.

widgets.label: Employee search box
widgets.detail: Physically the same input as on the other tab — placeholder 'Search by name or ID...', .input plus pl-9, a 16px slate-400 magnifier at left-3 top-3, w-full then sm:w-72. It filters this table by first name, last name or employee code (case-insensitive substring, each field tested separately), client-side, on every keystroke. A query typed on the Run Payroll tab is still in force here.

widgets.label: Salary Structures table
widgets.detail: Nine columns, in exactly this rendered order: 'Employee' | 'Basic (₹)' | 'HRA (₹)' | 'Special (₹)' | 'Conveyance (₹)' | 'PF (₹)' | 'ESIC (₹)' | 'Tax (₹)' | 'Actions'. Note the fourth header is the short word 'Special', not 'Special Allowance' — the long form appears only inside the modal. Header cells use .th (px-4 py-3, text-left, text-xs, font-semibold, slate-500, UPPERCASE, tracking-wider) on a bg-slate-50 thead, so they display as 'EMPLOYEE', 'BASIC (₹)', 'HRA (₹)', 'SPECIAL (₹)', 'CONVEYANCE (₹)', 'PF (₹)', 'ESIC (₹)', 'TAX (₹)', 'ACTIONS'. Body cells use .td (px-4 py-3, text-sm); rows are separated by divide-y divide-slate-100 and hover to bg-slate-50. The Employee cell is '{emp_code} - {first_name} {last_name}' at font-medium; the seven money cells are bare JavaScript numbers — the rupee sign lives in the header only, there are no thousands separators and no decimals; a missing structure surfaces as 0 (except Conveyance, which the server defaults to 1600). Rows are ordered by first name then last name. No row striping, no selection, no pagination, no sorting, no totals row, no gross or net column — this table shows components only, so the reader has to add them up mentally.

widgets.label: Row action: Edit
widgets.detail: One per row in the Actions cell: a .btn-secondary (white, 1px slate-300 border, slate-700 text, rounded-lg, hover bg-slate-50) shrunk with !py-1 and !text-xs, labelled simply 'Edit'. No icon.

widgets.label: Modal: Edit Salary Structure
widgets.detail:
Title 'Edit Salary Structure'. Panel max-w-lg (512px), max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, p-6, slate-900/50 backdrop, header row with the title at text-lg font-bold slate-800 and a slate-400 '×' at text-2xl, mb-4. Body is a <form class='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'> — a flat two-column grid, no space-y wrapper. Every label uses .label and therefore renders UPPERCASE.
SEVEN MONEY FIELDS, each <input type='number' step='0.01' min='0' class='input'>, in this order and with these exact labels (the '(₹)' suffix is part of every one): 'Basic (₹)', 'HRA (₹)', 'Special Allowance (₹)', 'Conveyance (₹)', 'PF Deduction (₹)', 'ESIC (₹)', 'Tax (TDS) (₹)'. VALIDATION IS SPLIT AND INVERTED FROM WHAT YOU'D EXPECT: Basic, HRA and Special Allowance are NOT required and are blanked to an empty box whenever their value is 0, so a brand-new employee opens with the three biggest earnings fields empty; Conveyance, PF Deduction, ESIC and Tax (TDS) ARE required (the form will not submit while any of them is empty) and display a literal 0 rather than blanking. min='0' blocks negatives on all seven; step='0.01' allows paise.
SECTION DIVIDER spanning both columns: a col-span-2 block with mt-4, border-t and pt-4 containing the heading 'Bank & Tax Details' at font-semibold text-sm mb-2 slate-700.
FOUR TEXT FIELDS, each <input type='text' class='input'>, none required, no pattern or maxlength validation of any kind, in this order: 'PAN Number', 'Bank Name', 'Bank Account No.' (note the trailing period), 'Bank IFSC'. Being a two-column grid, these four fill two tidy rows.
FOOTER: a col-span-2 block with flex justify-end gap-2, pt-4, mt-2 and border-t — 'Cancel' (.btn-secondary) then 'Save Structure' (.btn-primary with a 16px lucide Save icon).

widgets.label: Success alert banner
widgets.detail: Emerald banner above the tab strip — rounded-lg, 1px border, px-4 py-3, text-sm, bg-emerald-50, text-emerald-700, border-emerald-200 — reading 'Salary structure saved.' (with the full stop). Auto-clears after 4 seconds.

widgets.label: Error alert banner
widgets.detail: Red banner in the same slot — rounded-lg, 1px border, px-4 py-3, text-sm, bg-red-50, text-red-700, border-red-200 — carrying the API's message, e.g. 'Request failed'. Auto-clears after 5 seconds.

actions: Click the 'Run Payroll' tab — swaps back to the eight-column payroll run view; the month, year and cycle it had loaded are re-fetched from scratch because that sub-view remounts.
Click the 'Salary Structures' tab — already active here.
Type in 'Search by name or ID...' — live client-side filter of this table on first name, last name or employee code.

Click a row's 'Edit' — opens the Edit Salary Structure modal seeded from that row: the seven amounts, plus PAN, bank name, account number and IFSC pulled from the salary structure or, where that is blank, from the employee record. Conveyance falls back to 1600 when nothing is stored.
Close the modal via '×', 'Cancel', or a backdrop click — discards all edits, sends nothing.
Edit any field in the modal — purely local until submit; the table behind does not update live.

Click 'Save Structure' (submit) — PUTs every field to /payroll/structures/{employee_id}, which upserts the row. CONSEQUENTIAL AND UNCONFIRMED: this is the authoritative record of what the person is paid and where the money is sent, it OVERWRITES the previous figures outright, there is no are-you-sure step, no diff preview and no undo in the UI. The server writes a SALARY_STRUCTURE_UPDATED audit entry. A blank ESIC is treated as 'leave it alone' rather than 'set it to zero'. On success the modal closes, the green 'Salary structure saved.' toast appears, and both the employee list and the structures list are refetched so the table redraws with the new numbers.
Click any sidebar link or Logout — standard app-shell navigation.
states: Initial load — the whole page is a single centred spinner (32px, 4px border, slate-200 ring with a brand-600 top edge, inside flex justify-center py-16) until both /employees and /payroll/structures resolve. Shared with the other tab.
Zero active employees — the same guard leaves the page stuck on that spinner indefinitely; there is no empty state for this table either.
No spinner on this tab after load — unlike Run Payroll there is no per-tab loading state, because this table reads the structures already held by the parent. Switching to this tab is instant.
Search with no matches — thead renders over an empty tbody; no 'no results' copy, no clear-search button.

Employee with no saved structure — every amount reads 0 except Conveyance, which reads 1600 (the server's COALESCE default). Opening Edit on such a row shows Basic, HRA and Special Allowance as EMPTY boxes while Conveyance shows 1600 and PF, ESIC and Tax show 0. This is the common state for a new joiner and worth mocking as a frame.
Success — emerald 'Salary structure saved.' banner for 4 seconds, then it disappears and the layout shifts up.
Error — red banner for 5 seconds carrying the server's message.
Alert spacing quirk — the className='mb-4' passed to the Alert component is ignored, so both banners sit flush against the control row.

Validation block — pressing 'Save Structure' with Conveyance, PF Deduction, ESIC or Tax (TDS) empty is stopped by the browser's native required-field bubble on the first offending input; Basic, HRA and Special Allowance may be left blank and will post as empty.

Permission denied — gated on documents.manage exactly like the other tab: no sidebar link for users without it, red API error and empty table on a direct visit, 401 clears the session and redirects to /login.

Modal — closed by default, one at a time, scrolls internally past 90vh. The two-column grid keeps its shape on narrow screens (it is grid-cols-2 with no responsive override), so on a phone the fields become very narrow rather than stacking.
Mobile / narrow — tab strip and search stack vertically below sm; the nine-column table scrolls horizontally inside its card; the sidebar collapses to a hamburger drawer below lg.

title: Attendance Management
purpose: HR/admin screen to review one employee's monthly attendance calendar, see the whole company's status for a single day, bulk-mark attendance for any past date, map biometric machine IDs to employees, and export the month's attendance as CSV.
layout:
Full-page app shell, page background slate-100, main content padded p-4 (lg:p-8).

CHROME (components/AppShell.jsx, wraps every /admin/* route):
- Fixed dark sidebar, w-64 (256px), bg-slate-900, full height, visible only at lg+ (below lg it is a slide-over opened by a hamburger, with a slate-900/60 backdrop and an X close button).
  Sidebar top: 'FOne HR' logo mark (light variant, 30px) in a px-5 py-5 block with a border-b border-slate-800.
  Below it: a px-5 py-2.5 block bordered below - 11px uppercase tracking-wide slate-500 label 'COMPANY' over a text-sm font-semibold slate-200 company name ('Futurn').
  Nav (flex-1, overflow-y-auto, px-3 py-4, space-y-1): a section header 'MANAGEMENT' (11px semibold uppercase tracking-wider slate-500, px-3 pb-1) followed by nav links. Each link: flex gap-3, rounded-lg, px-3 py-2.5, text-sm font-medium, 18px lucide icon + label. Inactive = text-slate-300 with hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white; ACTIVE = bg-brand-600 (#1d4ed8) text-white.
  Nav items in order: Overview (LayoutDashboard, /admin), Employees (Users), Attendance (CalendarClock, /admin/attendance - THIS ONE IS ACTIVE), Leave Management (ClipboardCheck), Leave Balances (Calculator), Documents (FolderOpen), Reports (BarChart3), Analytics (LineChart), Settings (Settings), Email Log (Mails), Roles & Access (ShieldCheck - platform admin only). Below the section: Change Password (KeyRound).
  Sidebar footer: border-t border-slate-800, p-3, full-width Logout button (LogOut icon) text-slate-300, hover:bg-red-600/90 hover:text-white.
- Content column is lg:pl-64. Sticky white top header (border-b border-slate-200, px-4 lg:px-8, py-3, flex justify-between): left = hamburger (lg:hidden) + text-sm slate-500 'FOne HR - Managing: Futurn' (hidden on <sm); right = a notification Bell (only for non-platform users; red badge with unread count) then a right-aligned name block (text-sm font-semibold slate-800 name over text-xs slate-500 'HR - FTRN002') and a 36px round bg-brand-600 white-text avatar with 2 initials.

PAGE BODY, top to bottom:
1. PageHeader row: flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3, mb-6. Left: h1 'Attendance Management' (text-2xl font-bold slate-800) over subtitle 'View, edit, regularize and export employee attendance' (text-sm slate-500, mt-0.5). Right: one btn-secondary button.
2. Alert slot(s): a mb-4 div holding a red error Alert and/or a mb-4 div holding an emerald success Alert. Both are full-width rounded-lg bordered banners, px-4 py-3, text-sm. Absent when there is nothing to say.
3. Filter card: `card p-4 mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4` - a white rounded-xl border-slate-200 shadow-sm card. Inside: (a) a min-w-[260px] block with the Employee label + select; (b) a pt-4 block holding the MonthPicker (arrow / label / arrow).
4. While the month data is loading, a centered spinner (py-16) replaces items 5 and 6 entirely.
5. Stat card grid: `grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-6` - six equal cards.
6. Calendar card: `card p-6 mb-6`. h3 heading, a one-line xs helper paragraph, then the 7-column month grid, then the legend pill row.
7. Day Overview card: `card overflow-x-auto` (no top margin - it sits directly under the calendar card's mb-6). A px-4 pt-4 flex-wrap header row (heading left, date input right), then a full-width table with mt-3.
8. Device Mapping card: `card overflow-x-auto mt-6`. A px-4 pt-4 header block (heading + explanatory paragraph), a full-width table mt-3, an optional empty state, and an optional px-4 py-3 footnote listing employees with no device link. Rendered ONLY for platform admins at companies with biometric attendance; otherwise the whole card is absent (not an empty state - simply not in the DOM).
9. Two modal overlays (normally hidden): Edit Attendance (max-w-lg) and Bulk Attendance (max-w-3xl). Both are fixed inset-0 z-50, centered, p-4, over a bg-slate-900/50 backdrop; the panel is a `card` with max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto p-6, a flex header row (text-lg font-bold slate-800 title + a 2xl slate-400 hover:slate-600 '×' button, mb-4), then the body.

NOTE ON COLORS: brand-50 #f0f6ff, brand-100 #dcebfe, brand-500 #2563eb, brand-600 #1d4ed8, brand-700 #1e40af. Shared classes: .card = bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm; .btn-primary = bg-brand-600 text-white hover:bg-brand-700, rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium, gap-2; .btn-secondary = bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50, same metrics; .input = w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white with focus ring-2 ring-brand-500; .label = block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 UPPERCASE tracking-wide mb-1; .th = px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider; .td = px-4 py-3 text-sm. Tables are min-w-full divide-y divide-slate-200 with thead bg-slate-50 and tbody divide-y divide-slate-100, rows hover:bg-slate-50.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (AppShell)
widgets.detail: Dark w-64 vertical nav. Items in order with lucide icons: [MANAGEMENT section header] Overview (LayoutDashboard), Employees (Users), Attendance (CalendarClock) <- ACTIVE, highlighted bg-brand-600 white text, Leave Management (ClipboardCheck), Leave Balances (Calculator), Documents (FolderOpen), Reports (BarChart3), Analytics (LineChart), Settings (Settings), Email Log (Mails), Roles & Access (ShieldCheck). Then Change Password (KeyRound). Footer: Logout (LogOut, hover turns red). Above the nav: logo block, then a COMPANY label + company name block.

widgets.label: Top header bar
widgets.detail: Sticky white bar. Left: text-sm slate-500 'FOne HR - Managing: Futurn'. Right: Bell icon with a red circular unread badge (e.g. 3), then 'Priya Sharma' (text-sm font-semibold slate-800) over 'HR · FTRN005' (text-xs slate-500), then a 36px brand-600 circle with white bold initials 'PS'.

widgets.label: Page header + Export action
widgets.detail: H1 'Attendance Management' + subtitle 'View, edit, regularize and export employee attendance'. Right side: ONE btn-secondary button labelled 'Export CSV (9/2026)' with a 16px lucide Download icon on the left. Label template is literally `Export CSV ({month}/{year})` using UNPADDED numbers - September 2026 renders as '(9/2026)', October as '(10/2026)'.

widgets.label: Error / success alert banners
widgets.detail: Two mutually-independent full-width banners rendered above the filter card. Error: rounded-lg border, bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200, px-4 py-3 text-sm. Success: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200. Real strings that appear here: success 'Attendance updated', 'Bulk attendance saved (5 employees)', 'No changes to save', 'Device mapping saved - punches arrive on the next sync'; error 'Cannot mark attendance for a future date', 'Invalid status', 'Employee not found', 'date and non-empty entries[] required'.

widgets.label: Employee + month filter card
widgets.detail: White card, p-4, flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4. FIELD 1 (min-w-[260px]): .label 'EMPLOYEE' + a native <select class=input>. Option text template: `{emp_code} — {first_name} {last_name}` with an em dash, e.g. 'FTRN005 — Priya Sharma'. Options are every employee ordered by emp_code; the first one is auto-selected on load. FIELD 2 (inside a pt-4 wrapper): the MonthPicker - a flex gap-2 group of [btn-secondary !px-3 with a '←' arrow] [a min-w-[150px] centred block: line 1 = text-sm font-semibold slate-700 month label, e.g. 'September 2026'; line 2 = an optional 11px slate-400 period range, shown ONLY when the payroll cycle label differs from the month name - on THIS page the attendance grid is forced to calendar months so line 2 is always hidden] [btn-secondary !px-3 with a '→' arrow].

widgets.label: Working Days
widgets.detail: Metric label rendered as 'WORKING DAYS' (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide slate-500). Value: an integer count of days (no unit suffix), text-2xl font-bold slate-800. Unit = days in the selected calendar month excluding Sat/Sun and company holidays.

widgets.label: Present
widgets.detail: Label 'PRESENT'. Value = integer day count with status Present. NOTE: the code passes color='text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50' but that class is applied ONLY to the icon wrapper, and no icon is passed on this page - so the card renders as a plain white card with NO colour and NO icon. All six cards look identical: card p-5, flex items-start gap-4, grey uppercase label, big dark number.

widgets.label: Absent
widgets.detail: Label 'ABSENT'. Value = integer day count with status Absent. Intended colour text-red-600 bg-red-50 (not visible - no icon).

widgets.label: Half Days
widgets.detail: Label 'HALF DAYS'. Value = integer day count with status Half Day. Intended colour text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 (not visible).

widgets.label: WFH
widgets.detail: Label 'WFH'. Value = integer day count with status WFH. Intended colour text-cyan-600 bg-cyan-50 (not visible).

widgets.label: Late Marks
widgets.detail: Label 'LATE MARKS'. Value = integer count of records flagged late_mark across the month (counts days, not minutes). Intended colour text-orange-600 bg-orange-50 (not visible). IMPORTANT: there is NO stat card for Leave / EL / SL / LOP even though those statuses exist - the summary silently omits them, so the six numbers do not add up to Working Days when leave was taken.

widgets.label: Monthly attendance calendar (AttendanceCalendar)
widgets.detail:
Card with h3 'Calendar — Priya Sharma (FTRN005)' (font-bold slate-800, mb-1) and a text-xs slate-500 helper 'Click any day to bulk-mark attendance for all employees.' (mb-4).
HEADER ROW: grid-cols-7 gap-1.5, centred, text-xs font-semibold slate-500, mb-2: Sun | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat.
DAY GRID: grid-cols-7 gap-1.5. Leading empty divs pad the first weekday offset. Each day is a <button>: rounded-lg, 1px border, p-1.5 (sm:p-2), min-h-[52px] (sm:min-h-[64px]), text-left, transition.
  Line 1: the day number in text-xs font-bold. On the FIRST cell of the grid and on every 1st of a month, a short month name is appended in a lighter span (e.g. '1 Sep').
  Line 2 (text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-medium mt-0.5): the status. Desktop shows the FULL label, mobile (<sm) shows a short code. Mapping - Present/'P', WFH/'W', Half Day/'H', Absent/'A', Leave/'L', Earned Leave/'EL', Sick Leave/'SL', Loss of Pay/'LOP', Holiday/'HO', Weekend/'—'. (Desktop spells EL as 'Earned Leave', SL as 'Sick Leave', LOP as 'Loss of Pay'; all other statuses print verbatim.)
  Line 3 (optional, 9px, truncated, desktop only): the holiday name.
  Line 4 (optional, 9px sm:10px, tabular-nums, opacity-80, truncated): check-in – check-out, e.g. '09:12 – 18:40'. If only a check-in exists it shows '09:12'; if check_out equals check_in the dash and second time are dropped.
  Line 5 (optional, 9px, text-red-600): the word 'Late'.
CELL COLOURS by status (bg / text / border, all Tailwind -100 / -800 / -200 unless noted): Present emerald; WFH cyan; Half Day amber; Absent red; Leave purple; EL violet; SL orange; LOP rose; Holiday blue; Weekend bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 border-slate-200. An unrecognised status falls back to bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300. A working day with NO record: bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-400 and an empty line 2. A FUTURE day: bg-slate-50/50 border-slate-100 text-slate-300, line 2 shows an italic 9px 'Locked' (hidden on mobile), tooltip 'Future date (locked)', cursor-default opacity-85, NOT clickable.
HOVER on a clickable (non-future) day: hover:ring-2 hover:ring-brand-500, cursor-pointer.
TOOLTIP (title attr) on each cell: the holiday name if any, else the spelled-out status, else 'Future date (locked)'.

widgets.label: Calendar legend
widgets.detail: A flex flex-wrap gap-2 row, mt-4, directly under the day grid. TEN pills, in exactly this order: Present, WFH, Half Day, Absent, Leave, Earned Leave, Sick Leave, Loss of Pay, Holiday, Weekend. Each pill: inline-flex, rounded-md, 1px border, px-2 py-0.5, text-xs font-medium, coloured with the same cell colours listed in the calendar widget (Earned Leave = violet, Sick Leave = orange, Loss of Pay = rose).

widgets.label: Day Overview date picker
widgets.detail: Sits in the Day Overview card header, right-aligned. A native <input type='date'> with classes `input !w-auto !py-1.5` - so a compact bordered rounded-lg box, NOT full width. Its `max` is today's date, so future days cannot be selected. Defaults to today. Changing it reloads the table below.

widgets.label: Day Overview table (all active employees for one date)
widgets.detail:
Card heading: h3 'Day Overview — 21/09/2026' (font-bold slate-800). Dates are always DD/MM/YYYY.
COLUMN HEADERS, exactly and in order: Code | Name | Department | Status | Entry Time | Exit Time | Late
ROW RENDERING: Code cell is .td font-semibold. Name is plain. Department prints '—' when the employee has no department. Status renders a rounded-full Badge (inline-flex, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-medium, whitespace-nowrap) coloured by status - Present=emerald-100/700, WFH=cyan-100/700, Half Day=amber-100/700, Absent=red-100/700, Leave=purple-100/700, Holiday=blue-100/700, Weekend/unknown=slate-100/600, LOP=red-100/700, EL=purple-100/700, SL falls through to slate-100/600 (its 'orange' key is not defined in the Badge palette - a real quirk). When no status exists at all the cell shows a slate Badge reading 'Not marked'. Entry Time / Exit Time print the stored time, falling back to the biometric device time, falling back to '—'. Late prints 'Yes' or '—'.
Sorted by emp_code ascending. Active employees only. Rows are NOT clickable (no row action is wired). The card is horizontally scrollable (overflow-x-auto) on narrow screens.
When the date is a company holiday or a weekend, every employee with no explicit record gets that status automatically.

widgets.label: Device Mapping table (biometric machine -> employee)
widgets.detail:
Card heading h3 'Device Mapping — biometric machine → employee' followed by a text-xs slate-500 paragraph reading exactly: 'Names come from the BioMax device itself. Punches from unmapped machines are held back (never stored under the wrong person) and delivered on the sync after you map them.'
COLUMN HEADERS, exactly and in order: Machine ID | Name on Device | Mapped Employee
Machine ID cell is font-semibold. Name on Device prints '—' when the device sent no name. Mapped Employee is an inline <select> styled `input !py-1 !text-sm min-w-[240px]` whose first option is '— not mapped —' (empty value) followed by every employee as '{emp_code} — {first} {last}'. Changing the select saves IMMEDIATELY (no Save button, no confirmation) and flashes the green banner 'Device mapping saved - punches arrive on the next sync'.
Rows are sorted numerically by machine ID where the ID is all digits, then lexically.
EMPTY STATE (no rows): a centred text-sm slate-400 py-6 line 'No device roster yet — it appears after the first sync.'
FOOTNOTE (only when at least one employee is mapped to no machine): a px-4 py-3 text-xs slate-500 paragraph 'Employees with no device link: ' followed by a comma-separated list of 'First Last (CODE)'.
VISIBILITY: the ENTIRE card is absent for ordinary HR/tenant roles (the API returns 403 and the error is swallowed) and for companies without biometric attendance (404). Only a platform admin at a biometric-enabled company sees it.

widgets.label: Modal A - Edit Attendance (single employee)
widgets.detail:
Narrow modal, max-w-lg. Title template: 'Edit Attendance — 16/09/2026' (date in DD/MM/YYYY). Backdrop bg-slate-900/50, clicking it closes. Header has a 2xl '×' close button.
CRITICAL FIDELITY NOTE: in this version of the code this modal has NO trigger - nothing anywhere on the page opens it (the state that controls it is only ever cleared, never set). It is dead UI. Include it in the mockup only if a modal gallery is wanted; it is never reachable from the Day Overview table or the calendar.

widgets.label: Edit Attendance form (inside Modal A)
widgets.detail: space-y-4 form. FIELD 1: .label 'STATUS' + a full-width <select class=input> with exactly TEN options in this order: Present, Absent, Half Day, WFH, Leave, Holiday, Weekend, LOP, SL, EL. FIELD 2: an inline flex gap-2 text-sm slate-700 label containing a native checkbox and the text 'Late mark'. FOOTER: a flex justify-end gap-2 row with [btn-secondary 'Cancel'] [btn-primary 'Save / Regularize', which becomes 'Saving…' and is disabled while the request is in flight]. Submitting writes the remark 'Regularized by admin' server-side. Server-side validation rejects a future date ('Cannot mark attendance for a future date') and any status outside the ten above ('Invalid status').

widgets.label: Modal B - Bulk Attendance (whole company, one day)
widgets.detail:
WIDE modal, max-w-3xl, max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, p-6, over a bg-slate-900/50 backdrop. Title template: 'Bulk Attendance — 18/09/2026'. Header row has the title left and a 2xl slate-400 '×' close button right.
OPENED BY clicking any non-future day cell in the calendar. On open it fetches every ACTIVE employee's status for that date, pre-fills unmarked working days with 'Present', and locks Holiday/Weekend rows.
Body is a space-y-4 stack of four blocks: (1) toolbar, (2) stats bar, (3) scrollable grouped table, (4) footer action row. Each is specified as its own widget below.
CLOSING via Cancel, '×', or the backdrop discards all pending edits with NO confirmation prompt.

widgets.label: Bulk modal toolbar (search + department + quick action)
widgets.detail:
flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3.
BLOCK 1 (flex-1 min-w-[200px]): .label 'SEARCH EMPLOYEE' + a relative wrapper containing a 16px lucide Search icon absolutely positioned left-3 vertically centred in slate-400, and a text input `input pl-9` with placeholder 'Name or code…' (with a real ellipsis character). Filters case-insensitively on BOTH the employee name and the employee code.
BLOCK 2 (min-w-[180px]): .label 'DEPARTMENT' + a <select class=input>. First option is 'All Departments' (empty value); then every distinct department present in the day's roster, sorted A→Z. Employees with no department are bucketed as 'Unassigned', which therefore appears as a real option.
BLOCK 3 (inside a pt-4 wrapper, flex gap-2): ONE button - btn-secondary with `!text-xs !px-3 !py-1.5`, a 14px lucide CheckCircle icon, label 'Mark All Present'. It sets every currently VISIBLE (filtered) and unlocked row to Present; Holiday/Weekend rows are skipped. There is no 'Mark All Absent' or any other quick action.

widgets.label: Bulk modal stats bar
widgets.detail: A flex items-center gap-4 text-xs row. Item 1 (slate-500): a 14px inline lucide Users icon, then 'Showing ' + a BOLD visible count + ' of ' + the total roster count + ' employees', e.g. 'Showing 5 of 16 employees'. Item 2 (only when at least one row has been changed, text-amber-600 font-semibold): '3 changes pending' - pluralised, so a single change reads '1 change pending'.

widgets.label: Bulk modal employee table (grouped by department)
widgets.detail:
Wrapped in a `max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto border border-slate-200 rounded-lg` scroll box. Inside, a min-w-full table whose thead is bg-slate-50 STICKY top-0 z-10 so headers stay put while scrolling.
COLUMN HEADERS, exactly and in order: Code | Employee Name | Department | Status
GROUPING/ORDER: rows are grouped by department with departments sorted A→Z (so 'BenchSales', 'Design', 'Marketing', 'Unassigned'), and within each department employees are sorted by emp_code ascending. There is NO group header row - the grouping is expressed only through the Department cell.
DEPARTMENT CELL QUIRK (reproduce faithfully): the FIRST row of each department group renders the department name inside a chip - inline-flex rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 - while every SUBSEQUENT row in the same group renders the same name as plain text-xs slate-500. So each group visually begins with a pill and continues with bare text.
CELL STYLES: Code = .td font-semibold text-xs. Employee Name = .td text-sm. Department = .td text-xs slate-500.
STATUS CELL: for an editable row, an inline <select> styled `input !py-1 !text-sm min-w-[120px]` with exactly NINE options in this order: Present, Absent, Half Day, WFH, Leave, Holiday, LOP, SL, EL. (Weekend is deliberately NOT offered here even though the single-edit form offers it.) For a LOCKED row (the date is a company holiday or a weekend) the select is replaced by a read-only Badge showing 'Holiday' (blue) or 'Weekend' (slate).
ROW STATES: unchanged = hover:bg-slate-50; CHANGED (dirty) = bg-amber-50 and the select gains `!border-amber-400 !ring-1 !ring-amber-200`; LOCKED = opacity-60 (and it is excluded from Mark All Present and from the save payload).
EMPTY STATE, rendered directly beneath the table inside the scroll box: a centred text-sm slate-400 py-8 line 'No employees match the current filter.'

widgets.label: Bulk modal footer
widgets.detail: flex items-center justify-between, pt-2, border-t border-slate-200. LEFT: a text-xs slate-500 line that reads '3 changes will be saved' (pluralised - '1 change will be saved') when anything is dirty, and 'No changes made yet' otherwise. RIGHT: a flex gap-2 pair - [btn-secondary 'Cancel'] [btn-primary 'Save All (3)' whose number is the dirty count; it is DISABLED (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) whenever the dirty count is 0, and reads 'Saving…' while the request is in flight].

widgets.label: Loading spinner
widgets.detail: Shown in place of the stat card grid AND the calendar card while the selected employee's month is loading. A flex justify-center py-16 block containing an h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-slate-200 ring whose top border is brand-600. The Day Overview and Device Mapping cards load independently and are NOT covered by this spinner - they can appear while the spinner is still turning.

actions: Export CSV (9/2026) - btn-secondary in the page header. Fetches the month's attendance as a blob and triggers a browser download named attendance-2026-09.csv. The CSV's first line is the header 'Employee Code,Name,Date,Status,Entry Time,Exit Time,Late Mark'. The export covers the PAYROLL CYCLE (25th-to-24th by default), not the calendar month the calendar above shows - a deliberate mismatch. On failure a red alert appears; no navigation happens either way.
Employee dropdown change - reloads the six stat cards and the calendar for the newly selected employee. The stat cards and calendar blank out to the spinner during the fetch.

Month back arrow '←' / forward arrow '→' - step the calendar one month at a time, wrapping the year at January/December. Also changes what the Export CSV button label says and what it downloads. There is no upper bound: future months can be browsed (they render as all-locked cells).
Click any calendar day cell that is NOT in the future - OPENS the Bulk Attendance modal for that date. Future cells do nothing (cursor-default, tooltip 'Future date (locked)').
Bulk modal: type in Search Employee - live-filters the table by name or employee code, case-insensitive.
Bulk modal: change the Department select - filters the table to one department (or 'All Departments').

Bulk modal: Mark All Present - sets every currently visible, unlocked row to Present in one click. Holiday/Weekend rows are untouched. This is a bulk overwrite with NO confirmation and no undo other than Cancel.
Bulk modal: change any row's Status select - marks that row dirty (amber row, amber-ringed select) and bumps the pending-changes counter.

Bulk modal: Save All (N) - btn-primary. Sends ONLY the changed rows in a single transaction. On success closes the modal, refreshes the calendar, and shows the green banner 'Bulk attendance saved (5 employees)' (the employee word is pluralised). If somehow nothing changed it shows 'No changes to save' and closes without calling the server. Disabled while N is 0.
Bulk modal: Cancel / '×' / backdrop click - closes the modal and DISCARDS every pending change without any confirmation prompt. This is the one genuinely destructive-feeling path on the screen.
Day Overview date input - pick any date up to today to reload the whole-company day table. Future dates are blocked by the input's max attribute.

Device Mapping: change a Mapped Employee select - saves the machine→employee link IMMEDIATELY on change, with no Save button and no confirmation. Choosing '— not mapped —' unlinks the machine. Flashes 'Device mapping saved - punches arrive on the next sync' for 4 seconds.

Edit Attendance modal: Save / Regularize - writes the chosen status plus the late-mark flag for one employee on one date, stamped with the remark 'Regularized by admin'. NOTE: nothing on the page currently opens this modal.
Edit Attendance modal: Cancel / '×' - closes and discards.
Sidebar: navigate to any other admin page; Logout clears the session and returns to /login.
states: LOADING (month data): `data` is null, so the six stat cards AND the calendar card are both replaced by a single centred spinner. The filter card, the Day Overview card and the Device Mapping card remain visible and interactive.

LOADING (day overview / device map): these fetch independently with no spinner - their cards simply do not exist until the response lands, then pop in. This means the page can briefly render with only the header and filter card.

NO EMPLOYEES AT ALL: the Employee select renders empty, nothing gets auto-selected, and the month fetch never fires - so the spinner spins forever and the stat cards/calendar never appear. There is no 'no employees' empty state.

ERROR: a red banner appears above the filter card and PERSISTS - it is never auto-cleared and has no dismiss button; it is only replaced by the next error or cleared when the next bulk/mapping action starts.
SUCCESS: a green banner appears above the filter card and auto-clears after 3 seconds (single edit) or 4 seconds (bulk save, device mapping).

PERMISSION DENIED - Device Mapping: for any non-platform-admin role the device-map request returns 403, the error is swallowed silently, and the ENTIRE Device Mapping card is absent from the page. Ordinary HR users never learn it exists.
NOT ENABLED - Device Mapping: for a company without biometric attendance the request returns 404 and, again, the whole card is absent.
PERMISSION DENIED - Day Overview: if the overview request fails for any reason the error is swallowed and the whole Day Overview card is absent. No error banner, no empty state.
DEVICE MAP EMPTY: the table renders with headers only, and a centred slate-400 line 'No device roster yet — it appears after the first sync.' sits beneath it.
DEVICE MAP PARTIALLY LINKED: a footnote under the table lists every employee with no machine - 'Employees with no device link: Meenakshi Raghavan (FTRN014), Sourav Banerjee (FTRN016), …'.
CALENDAR FUTURE DAYS: every cell after today is greyed (bg-slate-50/50, slate-300 text), shows an italic 'Locked' on desktop, is not clickable, and carries the tooltip 'Future date (locked)'.

CALENDAR UNMARKED WORKING DAY: a plain white cell with a slate-200 border, the day number in slate-400, and an empty status line. Unmarked working days are deliberately not stored, so they render blank rather than as 'Absent'.

BULK MODAL - LOCKED ROWS: on a weekend or company holiday every row is locked at 60% opacity with a read-only Badge instead of a select, cannot be changed, is skipped by Mark All Present, and is excluded from the save payload. Opening the modal on a Sunday therefore yields a table where nothing can be edited and Save All (0) is permanently disabled.
BULK MODAL - NO FILTER MATCHES: the table headers remain and a centred slate-400 line 'No employees match the current filter.' appears below them; the stats bar reads 'Showing 0 of 16 employees'.
BULK MODAL - NO CHANGES: Save All (0) is disabled at 50% opacity with cursor-not-allowed, the footer reads 'No changes made yet', and the amber pending-changes chip in the stats bar is absent.
BULK MODAL - SAVING: the primary button reads 'Saving…' and both it and the row selects stay mounted; the modal is not blocked by an overlay.

SESSION EXPIRED: any 401 clears local session storage and hard-redirects to /login. After 15 minutes with no mouse, key, click, scroll or touch the shell logs out on its own and redirects to /login?timeout=1.

RESPONSIVE: below lg the sidebar collapses to a hamburger-opened slide-over; the stat grid drops from 6 columns to 3 (sm) to 2 (base); calendar cells shrink to min-h-[52px] and switch from full status words to single-letter codes (P / A / H / W / L / EL / SL / LOP / HO / —), and the 'Locked' text on future days disappears; both wide tables scroll horizontally inside their cards.

title: F1HR portal shell — sidebar + top bar + notifications
purpose: The persistent chrome every signed-in employee page renders inside: a dark fixed sidebar with permission-gated navigation, a sticky white top bar with the notification bell and user identity, and a right-hand notification reader drawer.
layout: Root div min-h-screen; page background is slate-100 (#f1f5f9), body text slate-800, font stack ui-sans-serif / system-ui / Segoe UI / Roboto. LEFT: fixed aside, inset-y-0 left-0, width 256px (w-64), z-30, background slate-900 (#0f172a); hidden below the lg breakpoint (1024px). On mobile the same sidebar renders inside a full-screen overlay (z-40) behind a slate-900/60 scrim, opened by the hamburger and closed by the scrim or an X button. Sidebar is a flex column, top to bottom: (1) brand row — px-5 py-5, border-b slate-800, the F1HR logo image (/logo-light.png, alt 'F1HR', 30px tall, width auto, object-contain) plus an X close button visible only below lg; (2) company block — px-5 py-2.5, border-b slate-800, an 11px uppercase tracking-wide slate-500 label reading 'Company' above the company name in 14px semibold slate-200, truncated; (3) nav — flex-1, overflow-y-auto, px-3 py-4, space-y-1, holding collapsible groups, a flat 'MANAGEMENT' section and single links; (4) footer — border-t slate-800, p-3, a full-width Logout button. RIGHT: a wrapper with lg:pl-64 containing a sticky top-0 z-20 header (white, border-b slate-200, px-4 at mobile / px-8 at lg, py-3, flex justify-between) and then <main> with p-4 at mobile / p-8 at lg. The notification drawer is a separate fixed z-50 overlay anchored to the right edge.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation — collapsible groups (employee view)
widgets.detail: Three collapsible groups, each a full-width button (px-3 py-2.5, rounded-lg, 14px medium, slate-300, hover bg-slate-800 + white) with a leading lucide icon at 18px and a trailing ChevronDown (16px) that rotates 180deg when the group is open. A group auto-opens when the current path starts with one of its children. Open groups reveal children indented ml-4 mt-1 with a left rail (border-l slate-700, pl-3), each child a link px-3 py-2, 14px, icon 15px, slate-400, hover bg-slate-800 + white. GROUP 1 'Home' (Home icon) → children: 'Home' /home (Home icon), 'Dashboard' /dashboard (LayoutDashboard icon). GROUP 2 'Attendance & Leave' (CalendarCheck icon) → children: 'Attendance' /attendance (CalendarCheck), 'Leave Balance' /leave/balance (Scale), 'Apply Leave' /leave/apply (FilePlus2), 'Leave History' /leave/history (History), and — only when the user holds the leaves.approve permission — 'Approvals' /leave/approvals (ClipboardCheck). GROUP 3 'Documents' (FolderOpen icon) → children: 'Salary Slips' /documents/salary-slips (FileText), 'Offer Letter' /documents/offer-letter (FileBadge), 'Company Policies' /documents/policies (BookOpen). Below the groups, a single flat link 'Payroll' → /admin/payroll (Banknote icon) appears only when the user holds documents.manage. Active link = bg-brand-600 (#1d4ed8) with white text; active child additionally font-medium.

widgets.label: Sidebar — MANAGEMENT section (permission-gated flat links)
widgets.detail: Rendered only if at least one item is permitted. Section header: 'Management' shown uppercase, 11px, font-semibold, tracking-wider, slate-500, px-3 pb-1, with pt-3 above. Items in this exact order, each gated by one permission key: 'Overview' → /admin (LayoutDashboard, employees.view); 'Employees' → /admin/employees (Users, employees.view); 'Attendance' → /admin/attendance (CalendarClock, attendance.view_all); 'Leave Management' → /admin/leaves (ClipboardCheck, leaves.view_all); 'Leave Balances' → /admin/balances (Calculator, balances.manage); 'Documents' → /admin/documents (FolderOpen, documents.manage); 'Reports' → /admin/reports (BarChart3, reports.view); 'Analytics' → /admin/analytics (LineChart, analytics.view); 'Settings' → /admin/settings (Settings, settings.manage); 'Email Log' → /admin/emails (Mails, settings.manage); 'Roles & Access' → /admin/access (ShieldCheck, platform admin only). A plain employee with no management permissions sees this whole section absent. Last item in the whole nav, outside the section: 'Change Password' → /change-password (KeyRound), always visible to everyone.

widgets.label: Sidebar — platform admin variant
widgets.detail: For a platform admin the employee groups (Home, Attendance & Leave, Documents, Payroll) are NOT built at all. Instead a single first item 'Companies' → /platform (Building2 icon) sits above the MANAGEMENT section, and the MANAGEMENT section only renders once a company has been selected. 'Roles & Access' is present. 'Change Password' still renders last.

widgets.label: Sidebar footer — Logout
widgets.detail: One full-width button, flex gap-3, px-3 py-2.5, rounded-lg, 14px font-medium, slate-300 text, LogOut icon 18px, label 'Logout'. Hover turns the row bg-red-600/90 with white text. Clears the stored session (localStorage keys fonehr_token, fonehr_user, fonehr_company) and redirects to /login.

widgets.label: Sticky top bar
widgets.detail: Left cluster: a hamburger Menu icon (22px, slate-600) shown only below lg, then a 14px slate-500 line hidden below the sm breakpoint reading 'FOne HR — {Company Name}' for a tenant user; for a platform admin it reads 'FOne HR — Managing: {Company Name}' when a company is selected, otherwise 'FOne HR — Platform Console'. Right cluster (gap-5): the notification bell (tenant users only), then a user block (gap-3) with right-aligned text — display name in 14px semibold slate-800 over a 12px slate-500 sub-line reading '{ROLE} · {EMP_CODE}' (e.g. 'EMPLOYEE · NOVA003'; role names in the system are OWNER, DIRECTOR, HR, EMPLOYEE) or the literal 'Platform Admin' for admins — followed by a 36px (h-9 w-9) circular avatar, bg-brand-600 (#1d4ed8), white, 14px bold, showing the first letters of up to the first two words of the display name, uppercased.

widgets.label: Unread notification count on the bell
widgets.detail: Rendered only when unread > 0. Absolutely positioned at -top-1 -right-1 of the bell button: height 16px, min-width 16px, rounded-full, bg-red-500, white 9px bold text, px-1, ring-2 ring-white. Shows the integer count of notifications where is_read is false. The bell itself is a Bell icon at 20px, slate-500, in a p-1.5 rounded-full button that hovers to bg-slate-100 / slate-800, title attribute 'Notifications'.

widgets.label: Notification bell dropdown
widgets.detail: Absolutely positioned right-0 mt-2, width 320px (w-80, max-w-sm), rounded-xl, border slate-200, white, shadow-lg, z-50, overflow hidden. Header strip: px-4 py-2.5, border-b, bg-slate-50, left '(Notifications)' as 12px bold slate-700 text, right a 'Mark all as read' text button at 11px font-semibold brand-600 (hover brand-800 + underline) shown only when unread > 0. Body: max-height 256px, overflow-y-auto, divide-y slate-100. Each row px-4 py-3, clickable, hover bg-slate-50; unread rows are tinted bg-brand-50/30. Row contents: title at 12px font-semibold (slate-800 when unread, slate-600 when read) with a 6px brand-500 dot pushed to the right edge when unread; body at 11px slate-500 clamped to 2 lines; timestamp at 9px slate-400 formatted DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS. Empty state: px-4 py-8, centred, 12px slate-400 italic, text 'No notifications yet.' Footer (only when there is at least one notification): a full-width button, border-t slate-200, bg-slate-50, px-4 py-2.5, 11px font-semibold brand-600, reading 'View all notifications'. Closes on any mousedown outside itself.

widgets.label: Notification reader drawer (NotificationPanel)
widgets.detail: Fixed inset-0 z-50, role=dialog aria-modal, aria-label 'Notifications'. A slate-900/50 scrim fades in over 200ms; the panel is an aside pinned inset-y-0 right-0, width 100% capped at max-w-md (448px), bg-slate-50, shadow-2xl, sliding in from translate-x-full to translate-x-0 over 200ms ease-out. HEADER: white, px-5 py-4, border-b slate-200, flex justify-between — left a Bell icon 18px brand-600 beside a 14px bold slate-800 'Notifications' heading over an 11px slate-500 sub-line that reads '{n} unread' or, at zero, 'All caught up'; right a 'Mark all read' button (CheckCheck icon 14px, 11px font-semibold brand-600, px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg, hover bg-brand-50) shown only when unread > 0, plus an X close button (18px, slate-400, p-1.5 rounded-lg, aria-label 'Close notifications'). BODY: flex-1, overflow-y-auto, p-4, space-y-2.5, one expandable card per notification. CARD: rounded-xl border bg-white; unread cards additionally carry a 4px left border in brand-500; the expanded card gets border-brand-500 plus shadow-sm. Collapsed card: a full-width left-aligned button (px-4 py-3, hover bg-slate-50) with the title at 14px (bold slate-900 when unread, semibold slate-700 when read), a 6px brand-500 dot when unread, a 12px slate-500 body clamped to 2 lines, an 11px slate-400 timestamp, and a ChevronDown 16px slate-400 on the right that rotates 180deg when expanded. Expanded card: the 2-line clamp is replaced by a border-t slate-100 section (px-4 py-3) holding the full body at 14px leading-relaxed slate-700 with whitespace-pre-wrap, and — only when the notification carries a link — an 'Open' text button with a trailing ArrowRight icon 13px at 12px font-semibold brand-600. EMPTY STATE: centred column with py-20, a Bell icon 36px slate-300, 'No notifications yet' at 14px semibold slate-600, and 'Leave updates and announcements will appear here.' at 12px slate-400. Opening a card marks that notification read; clicking a bell-dropdown row opens the drawer with that card already expanded and scrolled into view. Closes on Escape, scrim click or X (slide-out then unmount); page scroll behind is locked while open.

actions: Hamburger (below lg) — opens the sidebar as a mobile overlay drawer
Sidebar scrim / X button — closes the mobile sidebar
Any nav link — routes and closes the mobile sidebar
Group header button — expands or collapses that nav group (chevron rotates)
Logout (sidebar footer) — DESTRUCTIVE: clears the whole local session and redirects to /login
Notification bell — toggles the dropdown and refetches notifications; does NOT mark anything read
'Mark all as read' (dropdown) and 'Mark all read' (drawer) — marks every notification read; both controls disappear once unread hits zero
Notification row in the dropdown — closes the dropdown, opens the drawer with that card expanded, and marks that one read
'View all notifications' — opens the drawer with nothing pre-expanded
Notification card header (drawer) — toggles expand/collapse and marks that one read
'Open →' inside an expanded card — closes the drawer and navigates to the notification's link
Escape / scrim click / X — closes the drawer
Click anywhere outside the bell dropdown — closes it
states: Pre-auth: while the session is being read from localStorage the shell renders nothing at all (blank screen, no sidebar, no header)
No token or no stored user: immediate client-side redirect to /login before anything paints
Idle timeout: 15 minutes with no mousemove, keydown, click, scroll or touchstart clears the session and redirects to /login?timeout=1
Any API call returning 401 clears the session and hard-navigates to /login
Company block in the sidebar is hidden entirely when no company is resolved (platform admin who has not picked one)
Notification bell, dropdown and drawer are hidden completely for platform admins — only tenant users get them
Notifications are polled every 10 seconds and refetched on window focus, for tenant users only
Unread badge hidden at zero; 'Mark all read' controls hidden at zero; drawer sub-line switches to 'All caught up'
Empty notification list: dropdown shows the italic one-liner and hides its footer button; drawer shows the large Bell empty state
Below lg the sidebar is off-canvas and the main column loses its left padding; below sm the 'FOne HR — …' top-bar line is hidden
Menu items the user lacks permission for are not rendered at all — there is no disabled/greyed state, they simply do not exist

title: Welcome back, Arjun!
purpose: The employee's daily landing page: punch in and out for today, see the running month's attendance counters as bars, and read team leave intimations, upcoming holidays, birthdays and company announcements.
layout: Rendered inside the AppShell main area (p-4 mobile / p-8 at lg, on a slate-100 page). Single column, stacked top to bottom: (1) page header block, mb-6; (2) optional probation banner, mb-6; (3) 'Today's Attendance' card, p-6 mb-6; (4) 'Attendance Overview (This Month)' card, p-6 mb-6; (5) an outer grid (grid-cols-1, xl:grid-cols-3, gap-6) whose single child spans all three columns (xl:col-span-3) and stacks with space-y-6 — so in practice everything below is full width: (5a) the conditional 'Team Leave Intimations' card; (5b) a two-up sub-grid (grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-2, gap-6) of 'Upcoming Holidays' and 'Upcoming Birthdays'; (5c) the 'Company Announcements' card. Every card uses the shared .card style: white, rounded-xl, border slate-200, shadow-sm. NOTE for the mockup builder: this page builds an employee info-row array in code but never renders it — the profile detail list belongs to /dashboard only, and must NOT appear here.

widgets.label: Welcome header
widgets.detail: Flex row, wrap, justify-between, gap-3, mb-6. Title is an h1 at 24px (text-2xl) font-bold slate-800 reading 'Welcome back, {first name}!'. Subtitle sits directly under it at 14px slate-500 and is today's date rendered as the long weekday name (en-IN locale) then a comma, then DD/MM/YYYY with zero-padded day and month — e.g. 'Monday, 21/09/2026'. No buttons on the right.

widgets.label: Probation Period Active
widgets.detail: CONDITIONAL — renders only when the employee has a probation_until date that is still in the future (days left > 0). mb-6, rounded-xl, border pink-200/80, a left-to-right gradient from rose-50/80 to pink-50/85, p-4, shadow-sm, flex items-center justify-between. LEFT: an h4 at 14px font-bold rose-900 reading '⏳ Probation Period Active' (hourglass emoji included), then a 12px rose-700 paragraph: 'Your probationary period ends on {DD/MM/YYYY}. During this time, you can only apply for unpaid leaves.' — the date is inline, font-semibold, rose-800. RIGHT, right-aligned: the integer number of whole days remaining at 30px (text-3xl) font-extrabold rose-600, with 'days left' below it as a block at 12px font-semibold pink-600, uppercase, tracking-wider. Days are computed as a ceiling of (probation end − today) in whole days.

widgets.label: Today's Attendance — Check In / Check Out
widgets.detail: Card p-6 mb-6. Heading row: a LogIn icon at 18px in brand-600 (#1d4ed8) beside 'Today's Attendance' in font-bold slate-800, mb-4. Below, a flex row that stacks on mobile (flex-col sm:flex-row, sm:items-center, justify-between, gap-4). LEFT is two value blocks side by side with gap-8: block one has the label 'Check In' at 12px slate-500 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider, mb-1, and under it the value at 20px (text-xl) font-bold slate-800; block two is identical with the label 'Check Out'. Each value is the stored punch time as an HH:MM string, or the literal placeholder 'Not punched' when that punch has not happened. Unit: clock time, 24-hour HH:MM.

widgets.label: Punch buttons — Login / Logout
widgets.detail: Two buttons, gap-3, on the right of the Today's Attendance card, each py-2 px-6, 14px font-semibold, rounded-md, shadow-sm. 'Login' is bg-emerald-600 with white text (hover emerald-700); it is DISABLED — bg-slate-100, text-slate-400, cursor-not-allowed — as soon as a check-in time exists. 'Logout' is bg-rose-600 with white text (hover rose-700); it is DISABLED whenever there is no check-in yet OR a check-out already exists. So the three visual states are: both fresh (Login live, Logout dead), checked in (Login dead, Logout live), checked out (both dead). Pressing one posts a punch and writes the returned time straight into the matching value block without a page reload.

widgets.label: Attendance Overview (This Month)
widgets.detail: Card p-6 mb-6. Heading: CalendarCheck icon 18px brand-600 beside 'Attendance Overview (This Month)' in font-bold slate-800, mb-6. Body is a responsive grid — 1 column on mobile, 2 at sm, 4 at lg — with gap-8, holding four horizontal bar meters in this exact order: 'Present' (bar fill bg-emerald-500), 'Absent' (bg-rose-500), 'WFH' (bg-blue-500), 'Late Comings' (bg-amber-500). Each meter is a column: a top row with the label on the left at 14px font-semibold slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider and the value on the right at 24px (text-2xl) font-bold slate-800, aligned to their baselines (items-end), mb-2; then the track — height 12px (h-3), full width, bg-slate-100, rounded-full, overflow hidden, shadow-inner — with the coloured fill inside at a width of value ÷ 31 × 100%, clamped 0–100%, animating over 1000ms ease-out. Unit is DAYS. Present counts a Half Day as 0.5 so it can be fractional (e.g. 17.5); Absent, WFH and Late Comings are whole numbers. The window is the current ATTENDANCE CYCLE (which may start on a configured day such as the 26th), not the calendar month — but the heading only ever says '(This Month)'; no date range is printed.

widgets.label: Team Leave Intimations
widgets.detail: CONDITIONAL — the whole card is absent unless the signed-in employee has at least one direct report with leave activity (i.e. they are somebody's reporting manager). Card p-6. Heading: Users icon 18px brand-600 beside 'Team Leave Intimations' in font-bold slate-800, mb-1. Sub-copy directly under it at 12px slate-500, mb-4: 'Recent leave activity from your direct reports — for your information; HR / the Director handle approval.' Then a space-y-3 list of at most 6 items, newest application first. Each item is a rounded-lg box with border slate-200 and p-3 containing two lines. LINE 1 (flex, items-center, justify-between, gap-3): on the left the employee's full name at 14px font-semibold slate-800 followed by their employee code in parentheses in slate-400 font-normal; on the right a status pill. LINE 2 at 12px slate-500, mt-1, is a single interpunct-joined string: '{LEAVE CODE} · {from DD/MM/YYYY} → {to DD/MM/YYYY} ({days}d) · {reason}' — note the literal arrow character and the lower-case 'd' suffix on the day count. There are no approve/reject controls anywhere in this card; it is read-only.

widgets.label: Leave status pill (used in Team Leave Intimations)
widgets.detail: Inline-flex, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, 12px font-medium, whitespace-nowrap. The TEXT is remapped: the status 'Pending' is displayed as 'Awaiting Approval'; every other status is shown verbatim. The COLOUR map is: Approved → emerald-100 bg / emerald-700 text; Rejected → red-100 / red-700; Pending → amber-100 / amber-700; Manager Approved → blue-100 / blue-700; HR Approved → purple-100 / purple-700; Cancelled → slate-100 / slate-600; anything unmapped falls back to slate-100 / slate-600. (Same component is reused elsewhere with green/red/amber/blue/purple/slate/cyan; note the map also returns 'orange' for the SL status, which the badge has no swatch for and therefore renders slate.)

widgets.label: Upcoming Holidays
widgets.detail: Card p-6, left half of the two-up grid. Heading: PartyPopper icon 18px in amber-500 beside 'Upcoming Holidays' in font-bold slate-800, mb-4. A space-y-3 list of at most 4 upcoming holidays in ascending date order. Each row is flex items-center justify-between: the holiday name on the left at 14px font-medium slate-700, and on the right a BLUE badge (blue-100 bg, blue-700 text, rounded-full pill) carrying the date as DD/MM/YYYY. Empty state is a single list item at 14px slate-500: 'No upcoming holidays.'

widgets.label: Upcoming Birthdays
widgets.detail: Card p-6, right half of the two-up grid. Heading: Cake icon 18px in pink-500 beside 'Upcoming Birthdays' in font-bold slate-800, mb-4. A space-y-3 list of at most 5 employees whose next birthday falls within the next 45 days, soonest first. Each row is flex items-center justify-between: on the left '{First} {Last}' at 14px font-medium slate-700 followed by the employee code in parentheses in slate-400; on the right a PURPLE badge (purple-100 bg, purple-700 text) carrying the next birthday date as DD/MM/YYYY (the year is the upcoming occurrence, not the year of birth). Empty state, one list item at 14px slate-500: 'No birthdays in the next few weeks.'

widgets.label: Company Announcements
widgets.detail: Full-width card p-6 at the bottom. Heading: Megaphone icon 18px brand-600 beside 'Company Announcements' in font-bold slate-800, mb-4. A space-y-4 list of at most 5 announcements, newest date first. Each item has a 2px left border in brand-500 with pl-4, and three stacked lines: the title at 14px font-semibold slate-800; the body at 14px slate-600, mt-0.5; the date at 12px slate-400, mt-1, as DD/MM/YYYY. There is no empty-state message for this card — an empty list simply renders an empty <ul> under the heading.

actions: 'Login' button — records today's check-in; the Check In value immediately replaces 'Not punched' with the returned HH:MM and the button greys out permanently for the day
'Logout' button — records today's check-out; the Check Out value fills in and both buttons end up greyed
A failed punch surfaces as a plain browser alert() dialog carrying the server's error message (e.g. 'Already punched in for today'); nothing on the card changes
No other interactive controls on this page — holidays, birthdays, announcements and team leave items are all read-only, non-clickable
Navigation away happens only through the sidebar / top bar supplied by the shell
states: LOADING: the entire page body is replaced by a centred spinner — a 32px circle, 4px border in slate-200 with a brand-600 top edge, spinning, inside a py-16 flex container. No skeletons, no partial render

ERROR: the entire page body is replaced by a single alert box — rounded-lg, border red-200, bg-red-50, text-red-700, px-4 py-3, 14px — containing only the raw error message (e.g. 'No employee profile linked to this account')
PROBATION: the pink/rose banner appears above the attendance card only while the probation end date is in the future; it disappears the day it lapses
MANAGER-ONLY: the 'Team Leave Intimations' card is entirely absent for anyone with no direct reports
PUNCH: three mutually exclusive button states — not punched (Login enabled, Logout disabled), punched in (Login disabled, Logout enabled), punched out (both disabled)
EMPTY HOLIDAYS: 'No upcoming holidays.'; EMPTY BIRTHDAYS: 'No birthdays in the next few weeks.'; EMPTY ANNOUNCEMENTS: no message at all, just a bare heading
ZERO COUNTERS: an attendance metric of 0 still renders its label, the numeral 0 and an empty track
RESPONSIVE: the attendance metrics collapse 4 → 2 → 1 column, the holidays/birthdays pair stacks at below md, and the punch buttons drop below the check-in/check-out values on mobile
There is NO permission-denied state on this page — any authenticated employee with a linked profile can see it
The API also returns a biometric 'today entry' time for companies with device attendance, but this page does not render it anywhere

title: Welcome back, Arjun!
purpose: The employee's profile-and-directory view: their own master data and profile photo, a compact month/leave-balance summary, and a searchable directory of active colleagues whose rows open a detail modal.
layout: Rendered inside the AppShell main area (p-4 mobile / p-8 at lg, slate-100 page). Top to bottom: (1) the same page header block as /home, mb-6; (2) the same optional probation banner, mb-6; (3) a three-column grid — grid-cols-1, lg:grid-cols-3, gap-6 — whose columns are: LEFT a single tall 'employee information' card (p-6); MIDDLE a flex column with gap-6 holding the 'Profile Photo' card above the 'Current Month Overview' card (both h-fit); RIGHT the 'Active Employees Directory' card (p-6, h-fit, max-height 600px, itself a flex column so its list scrolls internally). Below the grid, outside it, sits the 'Employee Details' modal, which is only in the DOM while a colleague is selected. All cards are the shared .card style: white, rounded-xl, border slate-200, shadow-sm. On mobile the three columns stack in the order left, middle, right.

widgets.label: Welcome header
widgets.detail: Identical to /home: h1 at 24px font-bold slate-800 reading 'Welcome back, {first name}!' with a 14px slate-500 subtitle giving today's long weekday name (en-IN) then ', ' then DD/MM/YYYY — e.g. 'Monday, 21/09/2026'. mb-6, flex wrap justify-between, no right-hand buttons.

widgets.label: Probation Period Active
widgets.detail: CONDITIONAL, byte-for-byte the same banner as /home: mb-6, rounded-xl, border pink-200/80, gradient rose-50/80 → pink-50/85, p-4, shadow-sm, flex justify-between. Left: '⏳ Probation Period Active' at 14px bold rose-900 and a 12px rose-700 sentence 'Your probationary period ends on {DD/MM/YYYY}. During this time, you can only apply for unpaid leaves.' with the date inline in semibold rose-800. Right: whole days remaining at 30px extrabold rose-600 above 'days left' at 12px semibold pink-600 uppercase tracking-wider.

widgets.label: Employee information card (definition list)
widgets.detail: LEFT column card, p-6. Header block mb-5: the employee's full name as an h2 at 18px (text-lg) font-bold slate-800, and under it '{Designation} · {Department}' at 14px slate-500 (either half falls back to an em dash '—'). Then a definition list with divide-y slate-100; every row is flex justify-between gap-4 py-2.5 with the LABEL on the left at 14px slate-500 and the VALUE right-aligned at 14px font-medium slate-800. ROW LABELS IN THIS EXACT ORDER: 1. 'Employee Name' (first + last); 2. 'Employee ID' (the employee code); 3. 'Phone Number' (— when blank); 4. 'Emergency Contact' (— when blank); 5. 'Email ID'; 6. 'Date of Joining' (DD/MM/YYYY); 7. 'Date of Birth' (DD/MM/YYYY); 8. 'Designation' (—); 9. 'Department' (—); 10. 'Reporting Manager' (—); 11. 'Employment Status' — this value is a pill badge, not text; 12. 'Probation Period' — APPENDED ONLY when the employee is still on probation, and its value is plain amber-700 font-semibold text reading 'Active (ends DD/MM/YYYY)'. Rows 1–11 always render even when their value is an em dash.

widgets.label: Employment Status pill
widgets.detail: Inline-flex rounded-full pill, px-2.5 py-0.5, 12px font-medium, whitespace-nowrap, sitting in the value slot of the 'Employment Status' row. 'Active' renders emerald-100 background with emerald-700 text; 'Inactive' renders red-100 with red-700; any other value falls back to slate-100 with slate-600. The text is the raw status string.

widgets.label: Profile Photo card
widgets.detail: MIDDLE column, top card, p-6, h-fit. Label line: 'Profile Photo' at 14px font-semibold slate-700 with a border-b slate-100 and pb-2, mb-4. Below it a centred portrait frame, 160px wide × 208px tall (w-40 h-52), rounded-md, border slate-200, bg-slate-50, shadow-sm, overflow hidden. WITH A PHOTO: the image fills it object-cover. WITHOUT: a centred placeholder column in slate-300 — the employee's two initials at 36px (text-4xl) font-bold with mb-2, then 'No Photo' at 12px font-medium uppercase tracking-wider. UPLOAD AFFORDANCE (only for a platform admin or a user holding the employees.manage permission): hovering the frame fades in a black/60 overlay filling it, centred white 14px font-semibold text 'Upload Photo'; the whole overlay is a <label> wrapping a hidden file input that accepts image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp and image/heic (single file), and the input is disabled while an upload is in flight. When the viewer may upload AND there is no photo yet, a caption sits under the frame at 12px slate-400, centred, max-width 160px, mt-3: 'Hover to upload a passport size photo'. Users without the permission see no overlay and no caption at all.

widgets.label: Current Month Overview — Present / Absent tiles
widgets.detail: MIDDLE column, second card, p-6, h-fit. Section heading 'Current Month Overview' at 14px font-semibold slate-700 with border-b slate-100 and pb-2, mb-4. Then a 2-column grid, gap-4, mb-4, of two tinted tiles, each rounded-lg p-3, centred: TILE 1 bg-emerald-50 with border emerald-100 — caption 'Present' at 12px font-medium emerald-600 with mb-1, value at 20px (text-xl) font-bold emerald-700; TILE 2 bg-rose-50 with border rose-100 — caption 'Absent' at 12px font-medium rose-600, value at 20px font-bold rose-700. Unit for both is DAYS in the current attendance cycle; Present can be fractional because a Half Day counts as 0.5. No percentage, no bar, no delta.

widgets.label: Available Leaves
widgets.detail: Lower half of the 'Current Month Overview' card. Section heading 'Available Leaves' at 14px font-semibold slate-700, mt-6, mb-3, with border-b slate-100 and pb-2. Then a space-y-3 list with ONE ROW PER LEAVE TYPE, ordered by leave-type id, EXCLUDING the type whose code is 'UL' (Unpaid Leave), which is filtered out and must never appear. Each row is bg-slate-50, p-2.5, rounded, border slate-100, flex justify-between items-center: the leave type's full NAME on the left at 12px font-medium slate-600, and the remaining balance on the right at 14px font-bold brand-700 (#1e40af). Balance is accrued minus used and is frequently fractional (monthly accrual rates in the system are Casual Leave 1.0, Earned Leave 1.5, Sick Leave 0.75, Comp Off 0, Unpaid Leave 0). No unit suffix is printed — just the number. Empty state: a single centred line at 12px slate-400, 'No leave balances found.'

widgets.label: Directory search box
widgets.detail: Inside the directory card header, which is flex-col on mobile and flex-row at sm, items-center, justify-between, gap-3, with border-b slate-100 and pb-3, mb-4. The heading 'Active Employees Directory' sits left at 14px font-semibold slate-700, whitespace-nowrap. The search control sits right: full width on mobile, capped at 200px at sm; a lucide Search icon 16px in slate-400 absolutely positioned at left 10px / top 8px, and a text input with placeholder 'Search employees...', pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5, 14px, border slate-200, rounded-md, focus ring 2px brand-500/20 with border brand-500. It is an uncontrolled-feeling live filter — no submit button, no debounce, no clear button. It matches case-insensitively against the colleague's FIRST NAME or LAST NAME or DESIGNATION (a substring of any of the three is a hit); it does NOT match employee code, email or department.

widgets.label: Active Employees Directory
widgets.detail: RIGHT column card, p-6, h-fit, max-height 600px, flex column so the list itself scrolls (flex-1, overflow-y-auto, pr-2, custom scrollbar) while the header stays put. List is space-y-3. Each entry is a clickable <li>: flex items-center gap-3, p-2, rounded-lg, transparent border that becomes slate-100 on hover with bg-slate-50, cursor pointer. LEADING AVATAR, 40px (h-10 w-10), shrink-0: when the colleague has a photo it is a rounded-full slate-100 frame with border slate-200 holding the image object-cover; otherwise a rounded-full circle in bg-brand-100 with brand-700 text showing the two initials at 12px font-bold. TEXT BLOCK (min-w-0 so it truncates): the full name at 14px font-medium slate-800, truncated, over the designation at 12px slate-500, truncated, which falls back to the literal word 'Employee' when the colleague has no designation. Only employees with status Active are listed, sorted by first name ascending, and the signed-in employee is always filtered out of their own directory. No employee code, email or department is shown in the list row — those live in the modal.

widgets.label: Employee Details modal
widgets.detail: Opens when a directory row is clicked; not in the DOM otherwise. Fixed inset-0, z-50, flex centred, p-4, over a slate-900/50 scrim that closes on click. The dialog is the shared .card style at full width capped to max-w-lg (512px), max-height 90vh, overflow-y-auto, p-6. Title bar: flex justify-between items-center mb-4, with the heading 'Employee Details' at 18px (text-lg) font-bold slate-800 and a '×' close button on the right (slate-400, hover slate-600, 24px, leading-none). BODY, pt-2, space-y-4: first an identity strip (flex items-center gap-4, mb-6) — a 64px (h-16 w-16) rounded-full avatar showing the colleague's photo object-cover inside a slate-200-bordered frame, or, with no photo, a bg-brand-100 / brand-700 circle with the two initials at 20px (text-xl) font-bold; beside it the full name as an h3 at 20px font-bold slate-800 over the designation at 14px slate-500 (falling back to 'Employee'). Then a definition list in a rounded-lg bordered slate-100 container with bg-slate-50/50 and divide-y slate-100; every row is flex justify-between with p-3, the LABEL left at 14px slate-500 and the VALUE right at 14px font-medium slate-800. ROW LABELS IN THIS EXACT ORDER: 1. 'Employee ID'; 2. 'Mail ID' — the value is a mailto: anchor in brand-600 that underlines on hover, or an em dash when there is no address; 3. 'Contact No.' (— when blank); 4. 'Emergency Contact' (— when blank); 5. 'Date of Joining' (DD/MM/YYYY); 6. 'Department' (—); 7. 'Designation' (—); 8. 'Reporting Manager' (—). Note the abbreviated label 'Contact No.' and the label 'Mail ID', which differ from the wording on the left-hand profile card. There are no action buttons in this modal — no edit, no message, no close button at the bottom.

actions: Hover the profile photo frame (privileged users only) — reveals the 'Upload Photo' overlay

Choose a file through the overlay — uploads the photo and swaps the placeholder for the new image in place; the file input is disabled during the upload and a failure surfaces as a browser alert() with the server's message
Type in 'Search employees...' — live-filters the directory on first name, last name or designation as you type
Click a directory row — opens the 'Employee Details' modal for that colleague
Click the '×' in the modal title bar, or the dark scrim behind it — closes the modal
Click the 'Mail ID' value in the modal — opens the viewer's mail client on a mailto: link
No edit, save, delete, export or approve action exists anywhere on this screen
states: LOADING: the whole page is replaced by the centred 32px spinner (4px border, slate-200 with brand-600 top edge) inside a py-16 container
ERROR: the whole page is replaced by one red alert box — rounded-lg, border red-200, bg-red-50, text-red-700, px-4 py-3, 14px — showing only the error message
NO PHOTO: initials plus the 'No Photo' caption inside the portrait frame
UPLOAD NOT PERMITTED: no hover overlay and no 'Hover to upload a passport size photo' hint — a plain employee simply cannot upload, with no disabled control shown
UPLOADING: the hidden file input is disabled for the duration; no spinner or progress bar is drawn anywhere
PROBATION: the rose banner above the grid, plus an extra twelfth 'Probation Period' row appended to the profile list
MISSING FIELDS: phone, emergency contact, designation, department and reporting manager each render an em dash '—' rather than being hidden
NO LEAVE BALANCES: 'No leave balances found.' at 12px slate-400, centred; Unpaid Leave is always filtered out even when it has a balance
DIRECTORY EMPTY: 'No other active employees found.' at 14px slate-500 centred with py-4
DIRECTORY FILTERED TO NOTHING: the message changes to 'No employees match your search.' in the same style
DIRECTORY OVERFLOW: the card is capped at 600px tall and the list scrolls inside it while the heading and search box stay pinned
MODAL: only present while a colleague is selected; it has no loading state of its own because it renders data already held by the list
RESPONSIVE: the three columns stack to one below lg, and the directory search box goes full width below sm
No permission-denied state for the page itself — any authenticated employee with a linked profile sees it
