title: Settings
purpose: One page where HR/company admins configure the payroll-month cycle and probation default, maintain departments, designations, holidays and company announcements, and read the audit trail.
layout:
Wrapped in the shared AppShell (frontend/components/AppShell.jsx). FIXED LEFT SIDEBAR, 256px (w-64), bg-slate-900, hidden below lg and replaced by a hamburger + slide-over with a dark scrim. Sidebar top-to-bottom: (1) logo row, px-5 py-5, border-b border-slate-800, 'FOne HR' logo at 30px in light variant, plus an X close button visible only below lg; (2) company strip, px-5 py-2.5, border-b border-slate-800, an 11px uppercase tracking-wide slate-500 label 'Company' above a text-sm font-semibold slate-200 truncated company name; (3) nav, flex-1, overflow-y-auto, px-3 py-4, space-y-1 — for an HR user it shows collapsible groups 'Home' (Home, Dashboard), 'Attendance & Leave' (Attendance, Leave Balance, Apply Leave, Leave History, Approvals), 'Documents' (Salary Slips, Offer Letter, Company Policies), a flat 'Payroll' link, then a section heading 'MANAGEMENT' (11px, font-semibold, uppercase, tracking-wider, slate-500) over flat links Overview, Employees, Attendance, Leave Management, Leave Balances, Documents, Reports, Analytics, Settings, Email Log (and 'Roles & Access' only for platform admins), then a flat 'Change Password' link. Nav links: flex gap-3, rounded-lg, px-3 py-2.5, text-sm font-medium, lucide icon at 18px; inactive is text-slate-300 with hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white; ACTIVE is bg-brand-600 text-white — here the 'Settings' link is active. Group headers are buttons with a ChevronDown that rotates 180deg when open; children sit in ml-4 pl-3 with a border-l border-slate-700, at px-3 py-2 text-sm with 15px icons. (4) footer, border-t border-slate-800, p-3, a full-width Logout button with LogOut icon, text-slate-300, hover:bg-red-600/90 hover:text-white. MAIN COLUMN is lg:pl-64. STICKY HEADER: white, border-b border-slate-200, px-4 lg:px-8, py-3, flex justify-between — left is the hamburger (below lg) plus text-sm slate-500 'FOne HR — {company name}' (hidden on the smallest screens); right is the user block: right-aligned text-sm font-semibold slate-800 display name over text-xs slate-500 '{ROLE} · {EMP_CODE}', then a 36px rounded-full bg-brand-600 white-text avatar holding up to two uppercase initials. (The notification bell only renders for non-platform-admin users.) MAIN is p-4 lg:p-8 on a bg-slate-100 body.

PAGE BODY: PageHeader (flex, wrap, justify-between, mb-6) with h1 'Settings' at text-2xl font-bold slate-800 and a text-sm slate-500 subtitle; no right-hand action buttons. Then the error Alert slot (mb-4) and the success Alert slot (mb-4), each rendered only when set. Then ONE grid: grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6, containing six white 'card' panels (bg-white, rounded-xl, border border-slate-200, shadow-sm) in this DOM order: 1. 'Company Policy Settings' — p-6, spans BOTH columns (xl:col-span-2), and contains its own inner grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6. 2. 'Departments' — p-6, left column. 3. 'Designations' — p-6, right column. 4. 'Holiday Calendar' — p-6, left column. 5. 'Company Announcements' — p-6, right column. 6. 'Audit Log (latest 50)' — p-6, spans BOTH columns, its list capped at max-h-[420px] with its own vertical scroll and pr-1. Cards 2-5 each open with a bold slate-800 h3 (mb-4), then an add-form, then a divide-y divide-slate-100 list.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (AppShell)
widgets.detail: Dark slate-900 rail, 256px. Groups and links in order: Home > [Home, Dashboard]; Attendance & Leave > [Attendance, Leave Balance, Apply Leave, Leave History, Approvals]; Documents > [Salary Slips, Offer Letter, Company Policies]; Payroll (flat); MANAGEMENT section > [Overview, Employees, Attendance, Leave Management, Leave Balances, Documents, Reports, Analytics, Settings, Email Log]; Change Password (flat); Logout (footer). lucide icons in order: Home, LayoutDashboard, CalendarCheck, Scale, FilePlus2, History, ClipboardCheck, FolderOpen, FileText, FileBadge, BookOpen, Banknote, LayoutDashboard, Users, CalendarClock, ClipboardCheck, Calculator, FolderOpen, BarChart3, LineChart, Settings, Mails, KeyRound, LogOut. 'Settings' is the active item (bg-brand-600, white text).

widgets.label: Top header bar (AppShell)
widgets.detail: Left: 'FOne HR — Futurn Technologies Pvt Ltd' in text-sm slate-500. Right: name over role line, then a circular brand-600 avatar with initials. Sticky, white, border-b.

widgets.label: Error banner
widgets.detail: Only when an API call fails. rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm, bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200, sits in a mb-4 wrapper directly under the PageHeader. Holds the raw server error string, e.g. 'Cannot delete: 4 employee(s) are assigned to this department'. Does NOT auto-dismiss — it clears only when the next action succeeds.

widgets.label: Success banner
widgets.detail: rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm, bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200, in a mb-4 wrapper under the PageHeader (and under the error banner when both exist). Shows the server's message string and auto-hides after 4000ms. Known messages: 'Organisation settings updated successfully', 'Department added', 'Department removed', 'Designation added', 'Designation removed', 'Holiday added', 'Holiday removed', 'Announcement posted', 'Announcement removed'.

widgets.label: Company Policy Settings — Default Probation Period
widgets.detail: Left half of the two-column inner grid inside the full-width policy card. Card heading is an h3 'Company Policy Settings' prefixed with a ⚙️ emoji (font-bold slate-800, mb-1), under it a text-xs slate-500 line 'Configure company-wide policies for employee probation and leave accrual' (mb-4). Field: a text-xs font-semibold slate-600 block label 'Default Probation Period' above a full-width native <select class="input"> (rounded-lg, border-slate-300, px-3 py-2, text-sm, white). EXACTLY 7 options, value=label: 0='No Probation (Disabled)', 1='1 Month', 2='2 Months', 3='3 Months', 6='6 Months', 9='9 Months', 12='1 Year (12 Months)'. No Save button — onChange immediately PUTs /admin/org-settings and re-reads it. Below it, an 11px slate-400 helper: 'New employees will have their probation end date calculated automatically from their joining date.' Server validation: integer 0-120, else error 'Default probation period must be a non-negative number of months'.

widgets.label: Company Policy Settings — Payslip & Attendance Cycle
widgets.detail: Right half of the same inner grid. Label 'Payslip & Attendance Cycle' (text-xs font-semibold slate-600 block) above a full-width

widgets.label: Add Department (inline)
widgets.detail: flex gap-2 mb-4 directly under the 'Departments' h3. One text input, class 'input flex-1', placeholder 'e.g. Engineering', HTML required. One submit button 'btn-primary' (bg-brand-600, white, rounded-lg, px-4 py-2, text-sm font-medium) containing a 16px lucide Plus icon then the word 'Add'. Duplicate names return 409 'That department already exists'; blank returns 400 'Department name is required'.

widgets.label: Departments list
widgets.detail: ul, divide-y divide-slate-100, sorted by name ascending (server ORDER BY name). Each li: flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 — left is the department name in text-sm font-medium slate-700, right is a bare icon button, 15px lucide Trash2, text-red-500 hover:text-red-700.

widgets.label: Add Designation (inline)
widgets.detail: Identical layout to the department form but under the 'Designations' h3: text input 'input flex-1', placeholder 'e.g. Software Engineer', required, plus the same Plus + 'Add' btn-primary. Field name is 'title' not 'name'. Duplicates return 409 'That designation already exists'; blank returns 400 'Designation title is required'.

widgets.label: Designations list
widgets.detail: ul, divide-y divide-slate-100, sorted by title ascending. Each li: flex justify-between py-2.5, title in text-sm font-medium slate-700, Trash2 (15px, red-500) on the right.

widgets.label: Add Holiday (inline)
widgets.detail: flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4 under the 'Holiday Calendar' h3. THREE controls: (1) a native <input type="date"> with class 'input !w-44' (fixed 176px, min-height 38px, styled so an empty value shows a slate-400 placeholder instead of the browser's dd-mm-yyyy stub), required; (2) a text input 'input flex-1 min-w-[160px]' with placeholder 'Holiday name', required; (3) a btn-primary with a 16px Plus icon and the word 'Add'. Posting also fires an in-app notification to every user titled 'New Holiday Added 🗓️'. A second holiday on the same date returns 409 'A holiday already exists on that date'; a missing field returns 400 'Date and name are required'.

widgets.label: Holiday Calendar list
widgets.detail: ul, divide-y divide-slate-100, sorted by date ASCENDING. Each li: flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 — left is the holiday name (text-sm font-medium slate-700); right is a span with gap-3 holding a BLUE Badge (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-medium) followed by the 15px red Trash2 button. IMPORTANT: the badge prints the stored date string verbatim in YYYY-MM-DD form — this list does NOT run it through the DD/MM/YYYY formatter used elsewhere in the app.

widgets.label: Post Announcement
widgets.detail: A stacked form (space-y-2 mb-4) under the 'Company Announcements' h3. Fields: (1) text input class 'input', placeholder 'Title', required; (2) <textarea class="input" rows={2}>, placeholder 'Announcement text…' (note the single-character ellipsis), required; (3) btn-primary with a 16px Plus icon and the label 'Post Announcement'. The date is not asked for — the server stamps today. Posting also pushes an in-app notification to everyone titled 'New Announcement: {title}'. Blank fields return 400 'Title and body are required'.

widgets.label: Announcements list
widgets.detail: ul, divide-y divide-slate-100, sorted by date DESCENDING. Each li: py-2.5, flex items-start justify-between gap-3. Left column stacks three lines — title in text-sm font-semibold slate-800, body in text-xs slate-500, date in text-[11px] slate-400 with mt-0.5. Right is a 15px Trash2 button, text-red-500, shrink-0 mt-1. The date prints verbatim as YYYY-MM-DD. This card has NO empty-state text: with zero announcements it renders an empty ul under the form.

widgets.label: Audit Log (latest 50)
widgets.detail: Full-width card. Heading is 'Audit Log (latest 50)' preceded by an 18px lucide ScrollText icon in text-brand-600 (h3, font-bold slate-800, flex gap-2, mb-4). Body is a max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto pr-1 wrapper around a ul with space-y-2.5. Each li is a timeline entry: border-l-2 border-slate-200 pl-3, three stacked lines — the ACTION in text-sm slate-700 font-semibold (a raw SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constant, never prettified), the DETAILS string in text-xs slate-500, and a text-[11px] slate-400 line reading '{actor} · {timestamp}'. Newest first (ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50). Actor is the tenant username (which equals the employee code) or '{username} (platform admin)' for platform admins, or 'system'. Timestamp prints verbatim as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. The full action vocabulary that can appear: ACCESS_GRANTED, ACCRUAL_DAY_SET, ACCRUAL_RATE_SET, ANNOUNCEMENT_POSTED, ATTENDANCE_BULK, ATTENDANCE_EDITED, ATTENDANCE_EXPORTED, BALANCE_ADJUSTED, CYCLE_START_DAY_SET, DEFAULT_PROBATION_SET, DEPARTMENT_ADDED, DEPARTMENT_DELETED, DESIGNATION_ADDED, DESIGNATION_DELETED, DEVICE_ATTENDANCE_SYNC, DEVICE_MAP_EDITED, DEVICE_SYNC_FAILED, EMPLOYEE_CREATED, EMPLOYEE_DELETED, EMPLOYEE_UPDATED, HOLIDAY_ADDED, HOLIDAY_DELETED, LEAVE_APPLIED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_CANCELLED, LEAVE_EDITED, LEAVE_REJECTED, LEAVE_TYPE_ADDED, LEAVE_TYPE_DELETED, LEAVE_TYPE_EDITED, OFFER_LETTER_DELETED, OFFER_LETTER_DOWNLOADED, OFFER_LETTER_UPLOADED, PASSWORD_RESET, PAYROLL_EXPORTED, PHOTO_UPLOADED, POLICY_DELETED, POLICY_DOWNLOADED, POLICY_REPLACED, POLICY_UPLOADED, PROBATION_REMOVED, PROBATION_SET, PUNCH_IN, PUNCH_OUT, ROLE_CREATED, ROLE_DELETED, ROLE_UPDATED, SALARY_SLIP_DELETED, SALARY_SLIP_DOWNLOADED, SALARY_SLIP_GENERATED, SALARY_SLIP_UPLOADED, SALARY_STRUCTURE_UPDATED, TEST_EMAIL_SENT.

widgets.label: Delete confirmation (native browser confirm)
widgets.detail: Not a styled modal — every delete calls window.confirm() first, so a mockup should show the browser's own dialog or a plain equivalent. Exact strings: 'Remove department "{name}"?', 'Remove designation "{title}"?', 'Remove holiday "{name}"?', 'Remove announcement "{title}"?'. Cancel aborts with no request.

widgets.label: Badge component reference
widgets.detail: Shared pill used across all three screens: inline-flex, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-medium, whitespace-nowrap. Colour map — green bg-emerald-100/text-emerald-700, red bg-red-100/text-red-700, amber bg-amber-100/text-amber-700, blue bg-blue-100/text-blue-700, purple bg-purple-100/text-purple-700, slate bg-slate-100/text-slate-600 (default), cyan bg-cyan-100/text-cyan-700.

actions: Change 'Default Probation Period' — fires PUT /api/admin/org-settings instantly on selection (no Save button), then re-reads the settings so the derived cycle text refreshes; writes a DEFAULT_PROBATION_SET audit row.

Change 'Payslip & Attendance Cycle' — fires PUT /api/admin/org-settings instantly, then re-reads so the worked example, accrual-day sentence and end-day all refresh; writes a CYCLE_START_DAY_SET audit row. This is the page's highest-impact control: it re-groups every past month's attendance totals.
Add department — submits the inline form, then reloads all six data sets.
Delete department — Trash2 icon; browser confirm 'Remove department "{name}"?'; blocked by the server with 'Cannot delete: N employee(s) are assigned to this department' when in use.
Add designation — submits the inline form, then reloads.
Delete designation — confirm 'Remove designation "{title}"?'; blocked with 'Cannot delete: N employee(s) hold this designation' when in use.
Add holiday — date + name; also notifies every employee in-app.
Delete holiday — confirm 'Remove holiday "{name}"?'; always permitted.
Post announcement — title + body; also notifies every employee in-app.
Delete announcement — confirm 'Remove announcement "{title}"?'; always permitted.
Scroll the audit log inside its own 420px-tall pane (read-only; no filter, no search, no pagination, no export).
Sidebar navigation, group expand/collapse, mobile hamburger open/close, and Logout (clears the session and returns to /login).
states: INITIAL LOAD: all six data sets start as null and load in parallel, so each of the five list cards independently shows a Spinner — a 32px circle, border-4, border-slate-200 with a border-t-brand-600 arc, animate-spin, centred in a py-16 block. The Company Policy card never spins: it renders immediately with its defaults (probation 0, cycle start day 25, empty worked example) and snaps to the server values when they arrive.
EMPTY — Departments: 'No departments yet — add your first one above.' in text-sm slate-500.
EMPTY — Designations: 'No designations yet — add your first one above.'
EMPTY — Holidays: 'No holidays configured. Holidays are excluded from leave-day counts.'
EMPTY — Announcements: no empty-state copy at all; the list simply renders nothing below the form.
EMPTY — Audit log: renders an empty ul with no placeholder message.

ERROR: a red Alert under the PageHeader carrying the raw server message. Because all six fetches share one error slot, a single failing endpoint (typically /admin/announcements or /admin/org-settings, both of which need settings.manage) shows one banner while the other cards still populate. The banner persists until the next successful action.
SUCCESS: a green Alert under the PageHeader that disappears after 4 seconds; posting it also clears any error banner.

PERMISSION DENIED: the whole page requires settings.manage. A user without it never sees the 'Settings' item in the sidebar at all (the menu is built from the permission list), and hitting the route directly leaves every card spinning with a red Alert above them. /admin/departments and /admin/designations only need employees.view, so a user with employees.view but not settings.manage would see those two lists populate while the writes fail.
SESSION: 15 minutes of no mouse, key, click, scroll or touch redirects to /login?timeout=1; any 401 clears the session and bounces to /login.

title: Email Log
purpose: A read-only ledger of every notification the system sent or attempted, with the full message body on click, plus a one-button SMTP smoke test.
layout:
Same AppShell chrome as /admin/settings (256px dark sidebar, sticky white header, p-4 lg:p-8 main on bg-slate-100), with 'Email Log' as the active sidebar item under MANAGEMENT. IMPORTANT ORDERING RULE: the whole page short-circuits before the header renders — if the first fetch fails and no rows are held, the page body is JUST a red Alert with no PageHeader and no button; if rows are still loading, the page body is JUST a centred Spinner. Only once rows have arrived does the real layout render.

Loaded layout, top to bottom: (1) PageHeader — flex, wrap, justify-between, gap-3, mb-6 — with h1 'Email Log' (text-2xl font-bold slate-800) over a text-sm slate-500 subtitle, and on the right a single btn-primary 'Send Test Email'. (2) The error Alert slot (mb-4), then the success Alert slot (mb-4). (3) Either the empty-state card or the table card. The table card is a 'card' (white, rounded-xl, border-slate-200, shadow-sm) with overflow-x-auto, holding a min-w-full table with divide-y divide-slate-200; thead is bg-slate-50 with 'th' cells (px-4 py-3, text-left, text-xs, font-semibold, slate-500, uppercase, tracking-wider); tbody rows use divide-y divide-slate-100, hover:bg-slate-50 and cursor-pointer across the WHOLE row. Cells use 'td' (px-4 py-3, text-sm). There is no filter bar, no search box, no date range, no pagination and no column sorting — the server simply returns the newest 200 rows. (4) The detail modal, rendered on top when a row is clicked.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (AppShell)
widgets.detail: Identical to /admin/settings, with 'Email Log' (lucide Mails icon) as the active item instead of Settings.

widgets.label: Page header actions
widgets.detail: A single btn-primary button labelled 'Send Test Email' (bg-brand-600, white, rounded-lg, px-4 py-2, text-sm font-medium), right-aligned in the PageHeader. No icon.

widgets.label: Email log table
widgets.detail: EXACTLY four columns, in this order: 'When' | 'To' | 'Subject' | 'Status'. Column behaviour — When: whitespace-nowrap, prints the stored timestamp verbatim as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (NOT reformatted to DD/MM/YYYY). To: the recipient address, plain text. Subject: max-w-[340px] with truncate, so long subjects end in an ellipsis. Status: a Badge whose colour is computed — green (bg-emerald-100/text-emerald-700) when the status is exactly 'sent', red (bg-red-100/text-red-700) when the status STARTS WITH 'failed', amber (bg-amber-100/text-amber-700) for anything else, which in practice means 'skipped (SMTP not configured)'. The badge prints the raw status string, so a failure shows its whole reason inside the pill. Newest first (ORDER BY id DESC), capped at 200 rows. Every row is clickable and opens the detail modal.

widgets.label: Email detail modal
widgets.detail: Opens on row click. Fixed inset-0, z-50, centred, p-4, over a bg-slate-900/50 scrim that closes the modal when clicked. Panel is a 'card' at the WIDE size (max-w-3xl), max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, p-6. Header row: flex justify-between mb-4 — the title is the email's SUBJECT verbatim (text-lg font-bold slate-800), and on the right a text-2xl '×' button in slate-400 hover:slate-600. Body: first a text-sm slate-500 line reading 'To: {recipient}' with the address in font-medium slate-700, then ' · ' and the timestamp; below it, mb-3 apart, a <pre> with whitespace-pre-wrap, rounded-lg, bg-slate-50, border border-slate-200, p-4, text-sm slate-700, holding the FULL plain-text message body with its original line breaks and the aligned 'Field : value' blocks the mailer writes. The modal has no footer and no action buttons — it is read-only, closed by the × or the scrim.

widgets.label: Whole-page error state
widgets.detail: When the very first load fails and no rows are held, the page renders ONLY this: a red Alert (rounded-lg, border, px-4 py-3, text-sm, bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200) with the raw server message and no PageHeader, no button and no table.

widgets.label: Inline error banner
widgets.detail: Once rows exist, later failures (typically from 'Send Test Email') render a red Alert in a mb-4 wrapper between the PageHeader and the table. Does not auto-dismiss.

widgets.label: Inline success banner
widgets.detail: Green Alert (bg-emerald-50, text-emerald-700, border-emerald-200) in a mb-4 wrapper. Holds one of two server messages depending on whether SMTP_HOST is set: 'Test email queued to {address} — check the inbox and the Email Log status' or 'SMTP is NOT configured — the test mail was recorded in the Email Log only. Set SMTP_HOST/SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS and redeploy.' It clears after 1500ms and the table reloads at that moment, so the new row appears just as the banner disappears.

widgets.label: Empty state card
widgets.detail: Replaces the table when zero rows exist: a 'card' with p-12, flex flex-col, items-center, text-center — a 40px lucide Mails icon in text-slate-300 with mb-3, then 'No emails yet' in font-semibold slate-700, then 'Leave applications, approvals and new-employee credentials will appear here.' in text-sm slate-500 mt-1.

actions: Click 'Send Test Email' — POSTs an empty body to /api/admin/test-email, which addresses the mail to the signed-in user's own account email, records it in this very log, and writes a TEST_EMAIL_SENT audit row. It never asks for a recipient. After 1.5s the success banner clears and the table reloads so the new row is at the top. If the account has no email on file the server returns 400 'Provide a "to" address (your account has no email)'.
Click any table row — opens the read-only detail modal for that email. The whole row is the hit target, not just one cell.
Close the modal — via the × button or by clicking the dark scrim.
Horizontal scroll of the table card on narrow screens (overflow-x-auto).
Sidebar navigation and Logout.
states: LOADING: rows are null and the page renders ONLY a centred Spinner (32px, border-4, border-slate-200 with border-t-brand-600, animate-spin, inside a py-16 flex) — no header, no button.
HARD ERROR: the first fetch failed and there are no rows — the page renders ONLY the red Alert, with no PageHeader and no 'Send Test Email' button, so the user cannot retry from the page.
EMPTY: rows loaded but the array is empty — the centred p-12 card with the Mails icon and the two lines of copy replaces the table; the PageHeader and 'Send Test Email' button remain available.
POPULATED: the four-column table, newest first, up to 200 rows, with no pagination controls of any kind.

MIXED STATUSES: green 'sent' badges, amber 'skipped (SMTP not configured)' badges and red 'failed: …' badges commonly appear in the same list, because the deployment's SMTP config has changed over time. A red badge holds a long sentence and stretches its cell — whitespace-nowrap on the badge means the Status column can push the table into horizontal scroll.
TRUNCATION: subjects wider than 340px are cut with an ellipsis in the table but shown in full as the modal's title.
MODAL OPEN: body behind stays in place (no scroll lock); the panel itself scrolls when the body is long, capped at 90vh.

PERMISSION DENIED: the route needs settings.manage. Without it the 'Email Log' item is absent from the sidebar, and loading the route directly hits the hard-error state with the server's authorisation message.
SESSION: 15-minute idle logout to /login?timeout=1; any 401 clears the session and redirects to /login.
RESPONSIVE: below lg the sidebar collapses to a hamburger slide-over; the PageHeader wraps so the 'Send Test Email' button drops beneath the title; the table scrolls horizontally inside its card.

title: Roles & Access
purpose: Platform-admin-only console for defining company roles with permission sets and layering extra per-user permission grants on top of a user's role.
layout:
Same AppShell chrome, with 'Roles & Access' (lucide ShieldCheck) as the active MANAGEMENT item — this item only appears for platform admins. Because a platform admin is signed in, the header's role line reads 'Platform Admin', the header text reads 'FOne HR — Managing: {company name}', and the notification bell is NOT rendered.

Page body, top to bottom: (1) PageHeader with h1 'Roles & Access' and a text-sm slate-500 subtitle; no right-hand buttons. (2) error Alert slot (mb-4), success Alert slot (mb-4). (3) ROLES CARD — a 'card' with p-6 and mb-6. Its first row is flex items-center justify-between mb-4: on the left an h3 'Roles' in font-bold slate-800, flex gap-2, preceded by an 18px lucide ShieldCheck in text-brand-600; on the right a btn-primary 'New Role' with a 16px Plus icon. Under it, an overflow-x-auto wrapper around a min-w-full table with divide-y divide-slate-200, a bg-slate-50 thead using 'th' cells, and a tbody with divide-y divide-slate-100 and hover:bg-slate-50 rows. (4) PER-USER CARD — a 'card' with p-6 (no bottom margin). It opens with an h3 'Per-User Access Grants' (font-bold slate-800, mb-1), then a text-sm slate-500 explanatory paragraph (mb-4), then the same overflow-x-auto + table structure. (5) Two modals stacked after the cards in the DOM, only one open at a time. Neither card has a filter bar, search box or pagination; both tables show every row the API returns.

widgets.label: Sidebar navigation (AppShell)
widgets.detail: As on the other admin pages, but the signed-in user is a platform admin, so the sidebar begins with a 'Companies' link (lucide Building2, href /platform), omits the employee self-service groups (Home, Attendance & Leave, Documents, Payroll) entirely, and shows the full MANAGEMENT section ending with the active 'Roles & Access' item, then 'Change Password' and the Logout footer.

widgets.label: Roles table
widgets.detail: EXACTLY four columns in this order: 'Role' | 'Type' | 'Permissions' | 'Actions'. The Actions header carries text-right. Cells — Role: the role name in td font-semibold, always stored and displayed UPPERCASE (the API uppercases on save). Type: a Badge, blue reading 'System' when is_system is true, purple reading 'Custom' otherwise. Permissions: a flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-w-xl bag of default SLATE badges, one per permission key, each printing the raw dotted key (e.g. 'attendance.view_all'); when the role holds none, a single text-xs slate-400 line 'Self-service only' appears instead. Actions: rendered ONLY for non-system rows — a flex justify-end gap-1.5 pair of icon buttons, a 16px lucide Pencil with title 'Edit' (p-1.5, rounded, hover:bg-slate-200, text-slate-600) and a 16px lucide Trash2 with title 'Delete' (p-1.5, rounded, hover:bg-red-100, text-red-600). System rows leave the cell completely blank. Row order is server-side: all system roles first (is_system DESC) then by name, so DIRECTOR, EMPLOYEE, HR, OWNER come first alphabetically, followed by the custom roles alphabetically. A full-permission role prints all twelve badges and wraps onto several lines, making those rows noticeably taller.

widgets.label: Per-User Access Grants table
widgets.detail: EXACTLY four columns in this order: 'User' | 'Role' | 'Extra Grants' | 'Actions'. The Actions header carries text-right and its cells are text-right. Cells — User: two stacked lines, the employee's full name in font-medium slate-800 (falling back to the username when there is no linked employee), and beneath it the account email in text-xs slate-500. Role: a single BLUE Badge with the role name, or a blue badge containing an em dash '—' when the user has no role. Extra Grants: a flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-w-md bag of AMBER badges, one per extra permission key; when there are none, a text-xs slate-400 'None'. Actions: a btn-secondary button labelled 'Edit Access' with a tightened vertical padding override (!py-1.5) — white background, border-slate-300, text-slate-700, hover:bg-slate-50. Rows are ordered by username ascending, and since employee usernames are their employee codes, this is effectively employee-code order.

widgets.label: Permission checklist (shared sub-component)
widgets.detail: Used inside BOTH modals. A grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 block, capped at max-h-72 with its own vertical scroll and pr-1. Each permission is a <label> card: flex items-start gap-2, rounded-lg, border, p-2.5, text-sm; enabled cards are border-slate-200 with hover:border-brand-400 and cursor-pointer, disabled cards are bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 opacity-60. Inside each: a native checkbox (mt-0.5), then the permission KEY in font-medium slate-700, then on its own line the human label in text-xs slate-500. A DISABLED entry is force-checked and has ' (from role)' appended to its description line. THE TWELVE PERMISSIONS, in the exact order the API returns them — key then label: employees.view = 'View employees'; employees.manage = 'Add / edit / delete employees, reset passwords'; attendance.view_all = 'View all attendance'; attendance.manage = 'Edit / regularize attendance'; attendance.export = 'Export attendance reports'; leaves.view_all = 'View all leave applications'; leaves.approve = 'Approve / reject leave'; balances.manage = 'Manage leave balances & accrual rates'; documents.manage = 'Upload / manage documents & salary slips'; reports.view = 'View reports'; analytics.view = 'View analytics'; settings.manage = 'Manage settings (holidays, announcements, org)'.

widgets.label: New Role / Edit Role modal
widgets.detail: WIDE modal (max-w-3xl), centred over a bg-slate-900/50 scrim that closes it, panel is a card with max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, p-6, a text-lg font-bold slate-800 title and a text-2xl '×' close button. TITLE is 'New Role' when creating and 'Edit Role — {ROLE NAME}' when editing. Body is a form with space-y-4: (1) a 'label' class label reading 'Role Name' (block, text-xs, font-semibold, slate-600, UPPERCASE, tracking-wide, mb-1 — so it renders as 'ROLE NAME') above a full-width text input class 'input' with placeholder 'e.g. TEAM LEAD', HTML required; whatever is typed is uppercased by the server on save. (2) a 'label' reading 'Permissions' (rendering as 'PERMISSIONS') above the twelve-item permission checklist, with NO entries disabled in this modal — every one of the twelve is freely tickable. (3) a footer row, flex justify-end gap-2, holding a type=button btn-secondary 'Cancel' and a submit btn-primary 'Save Role'. Server responses: 'Role created' (201) or 'Role updated'; a duplicate name returns 409 'A role with that name already exists'; attempting to edit a system role returns 400 'System roles (OWNER, DIRECTOR, HR, EMPLOYEE) cannot be edited'.

widgets.label: Access Grants modal
widgets.detail: WIDE modal (max-w-3xl), same shell as above. TITLE is 'Access Grants — {user's full name}', falling back to the username. Body is a form with space-y-4: (1) a text-sm slate-500 sentence reading 'Permissions already provided by the [blue Badge with the role name] role are shown greyed out.' — the role name is a real inline blue Badge component, not plain text. (2) the twelve-item permission checklist, where every key already granted by the user's ROLE is rendered disabled: force-checked, bg-slate-50, opacity-60, un-clickable, with ' (from role)' appended to its description. Only the remaining keys are tickable, and those are the user's extra grants. (3) a footer row, flex justify-end gap-2, with a type=button btn-secondary 'Cancel' and a submit btn-primary 'Save Access'. Saving REPLACES the user's whole extra-grant set (it is not additive) and writes an ACCESS_GRANTED audit row. Server message: 'Access updated for {username}'. For a user whose role is OWNER or DIRECTOR, all twelve entries are disabled and the form has nothing left to tick.

widgets.label: Delete role confirmation (native browser confirm)
widgets.detail: window.confirm() with the exact string 'Delete role "{ROLE NAME}"?'. Cancel aborts with no request. The server refuses when the role is in use, returning 400 'Cannot delete: N user(s) hold this role', and refuses system roles with 'System roles cannot be deleted'. On success the message is 'Role deleted'.

widgets.label: Error banner
widgets.detail: Red Alert (bg-red-50, text-red-700, border-red-200) in a mb-4 wrapper under the PageHeader, carrying the raw server message. Shared by all three fetches and by both modal submissions; it does not auto-dismiss.

widgets.label: Success banner
widgets.detail: Green Alert (bg-emerald-50, text-emerald-700, border-emerald-200) in a mb-4 wrapper under the PageHeader, auto-hiding after 4000ms. Messages: 'Role created', 'Role updated', 'Role deleted', 'Access updated for {username}'. Appears AFTER the modal has already closed and the tables have reloaded.

actions: Click 'New Role' — opens the role modal empty, with no permissions ticked.
Click the Pencil icon on a custom role — opens the role modal pre-filled with that role's name and its ticked permissions; the title becomes 'Edit Role — {NAME}'. System rows have no Pencil.
Click the Trash2 icon on a custom role — browser confirm 'Delete role "{NAME}"?', then DELETE; blocked with 'Cannot delete: N user(s) hold this role' when the role is assigned.
Submit 'Save Role' — POST for a new role or PUT for an existing one; closes the modal, reloads all three data sets, then flashes the green banner.
Click 'Edit Access' on a user row — opens the grants modal seeded with that user's current extra permissions, with the role-provided ones greyed out and force-checked.
Submit 'Save Access' — PUT that REPLACES the user's extra grants wholesale; closes the modal, reloads, flashes the banner, and writes an ACCESS_GRANTED audit entry visible on /admin/settings.
Toggle any enabled checkbox in either modal; clicking a disabled (from-role) card does nothing.
Cancel or × or scrim-click to dismiss either modal, discarding changes.
Horizontal scroll of either table on narrow screens.
Sidebar navigation and Logout.
states: LOADING: roles and users start null and load independently, so each card shows its own centred Spinner (32px, border-4, animate-spin) inside its p-6 card while the headings, the 'New Role' button and the explanatory paragraph are already visible. The permission catalogue starts as an empty array, so a modal opened before it arrives would render an empty checklist.

ERROR: a single shared red Alert under the PageHeader. Because /access/roles only needs employees.view while /access/users needs platform-admin rights, a non-admin with employees.view sees the roles table populate while the users card spins forever behind an error banner.
SUCCESS: green Alert under the PageHeader for 4 seconds after any role or grant change.

EMPTY — Roles: cannot realistically be empty; four system roles (OWNER, DIRECTOR, HR, EMPLOYEE) are created in every company schema. With zero CUSTOM roles the table simply has four rows and no Actions buttons anywhere.
EMPTY — Permissions cell: a role with no permissions renders the text-xs slate-400 phrase 'Self-service only' instead of badges — this is what EMPLOYEE always shows.
EMPTY — Extra Grants cell: 'None' in text-xs slate-400.
CONDITIONAL — Actions column: entirely blank for is_system rows; the Edit/Delete pair renders only for custom roles.
CONDITIONAL — missing role: a user with no role_id shows a blue badge containing an em dash, and the grants modal's sentence renders an empty badge.
CONDITIONAL — fully-covered user: for an OWNER or DIRECTOR every checklist item is disabled and greyed, so the grants form can only be cancelled.

PERMISSION DENIED: every write endpoint here is platform-admin only. A tenant user — even a DIRECTOR with all twelve permissions — never sees 'Roles & Access' in the sidebar, because that item is gated on the platform-admin flag rather than on a permission key.
MODAL BEHAVIOUR: the checklist scrolls inside its own 288px-tall pane (max-h-72), the panel scrolls at 90vh, and the page behind does not scroll-lock.
SESSION: 15-minute idle logout to /login?timeout=1; any 401 clears the session and redirects to /login.
RESPONSIVE: the permission checklist drops from two columns to one below the sm breakpoint; both tables scroll horizontally inside their cards; the sidebar becomes a hamburger slide-over below lg.
